12828050.say: The colony ship is coming at last. And Celestia is riding on it. After forty years, it came Back.

14445224.say: Rumble is going home with me, Ee-ee-tees. So are my robots. And so is your map.

16130060.say: Lux... we found every light-stone. Every word the Gardeners left. Shall we say hello?

19719194.say: This tower is too high to jump. As Atalanta, Climb the handholds: keep pushing into the wall. Up top, stand by the edge above Jason and she pulls him up. The red switch up there needs his Ground Pound!

24625697.say: Weeder Drones! Ee-ee-tees sent them to spoil the garden. When a tank glows, a gold circle appears under you: step off it before the weed-killer splashes!

39309266.say: Ping! The sonar shows the open doorway in Green. Then swim through that one.

41400401.say: And turn while you hold it up: the bounced beam goes where the shield points. Light a crystal with it!

43184066.say: Let me guess: it means brave?

43887549.say: ...Good machine. You were never meant to be a weapon. Neither was I.

45894745.say: Dovey went a little late. Go the moment the rocks Open, never while they rumble and glow!

54381038.say: The scientists call it Celestia: the heart of every plant on Gaia Nova. If the heart were gone, this planet would stop fighting us.

66190887.say: Gold buoys ahead on the sonar. They are... humming?

66245885.say: Two Eyes Watch This Hall. Nobody Can Sneak Past Two Eyes.

66531141.say: You found a Toy in my forge? How sweet. Anvil drones! Drop something heavy on it.

82638480.say: Lift to S-S-Security. Gas-koo is so... warm. So... pretty...

89167099.say: A big golden sheep. Ee-ee-tees, you have more money than sense.

89419665.say: Thank you for the robot, boy. A clever little drone like that will make a fine soldier for my Legion.

90886763.say: All aboard the cable car! Hop on and ride it across the gap.

92108313.say: Look, Lux. Even the broken vines are all pointing up.

09a633bf.say: Secret Vault Lock. Step on the glowing tiles in this order: Gold, then Pink, then Blue. Step on a wrong one and the code resets!

e725d7f9.say: Tap Jump to hop up the ledge. Hold Jump longer to jump higher!

4234e52f.say: Enemies ahead! Hold Blast to shoot. It aims for you. The door opens when the room is clear.

613f8eca.say: Red switches need a Ground Pound. Jump, then press Spin in mid-air to slam down!

daddd576.say: Thawing complete! Good morning, crew member. You have been asleep for one hundred years. ...Just kidding. Six months.

78f7bb35.say: Brrr... Halcyon? Why is everything covered in ice... and pink vines?

34b2ded2.say: A space vine has grown over the whole ship: the Galactic Cuscuta Echinochloa. Gas-koo, for short. Everyone else is frozen in their pods or wrapped up in cocoons.

1427a13b.say: Worse news: Gas-koo has steered us toward a star. Someone has to climb up to the Bridge, six decks above us, and turn us around.

21c6a1e0.say: You are the only person awake, junior engineer Jason. So yes! Congratulations!

43bbfc2d.say: Okay. Okay! Deep breath. Let’s do this.

faa9ddd0.say: Captain’s log. This is Captain Argus. A glowing comet just hit the hull. Wait... it isn’t a comet. It’s Alive.

88fb2d83.say: It’s growing through the air vents! Everyone, stay in your pods. Lux? Lux, where did you go?

10694eef.say: If anyone finds my little repair drone: he hides in the storeroom when he’s scared. Please look after him.

665f2f61.say: That sealed door needs a drone to hack it. The storeroom is to the west. It is very dark in there... be brave, Jason.

edc6a1a3.say: Hey, little guy. You must be Lux. Hold still, I’ll fix that loose wire...

535e5c7e.say: Bzzzt! Lux... online! Oh! Oh! A Human! Hello, hello, hello!

9126a91e.say: I was hiding. The dark is scary. And the vines are scary. And the big Bang was very, Very scary.

87ebfcf7.say: The Captain is looking for you. He left a message. Want to come with me to the Bridge?

cca1c2ba.say: The Captain! Yes! I can light up dark places, zap bad guys and Hack terminals. Walk up to one and press the button!

077c0c60.say: Just... stay close, okay? I will be brave if you are brave.

4d118109.say: Warning! The Frost Warden guards the lift, and Gas-koo’s vines have scrambled its brain!

5eed73ff.say: Jump over its ice rings! When its chest hatch opens, Blast the glowing core!

0a5282bd.say: We did it! The Warden is just a sleepy old robot again.

52b8d1c6.say: The lift is unlocked. Next stop: Hydroponics!

1b091053.say: A memory shard! Gas-koo crystals remember things. Look, it is showing a picture...

6e0afbb3.say: ...cold... so cold and dark out here between the stars...

4daf1dbf.say: That felt so lonely. There are 18 shards on the ship. Let’s find them all!

d6025bc9.say: A giant warm ship, full of lights! Maybe... a friend?

c00778de.say: I held on tight to the ship. I only wanted to be warm.

beaf86c5.say: Gas-koo was scared of the dark... just like me.

2f2fedbc.say: Secret Vault (up on the ledge). Ground Pound all Three red switches in this garden within 21 seconds. The clock starts with the first one, so plan your route!

eaf6dd50.say: Too high to jump? Press Jump, then press Jump again in mid-air to fire your Jet Boots!

dca787f8.say: Snappers bite when you get close. Blast them from a distance, or Spin when they open wide!

a6366a21.say: Everything is so Green! And bitey. Some of those plants are definitely bitey.

41d3c5fc.say: There are prototype Jet Boots in the seed vault, across the sludge river. With them you can jump twice as high!

6bf00578.say: Captain’s log, day two. Gas-koo went straight for the gardens. It loves light and water.

86103da0.say: It keeps wrapping sleeping people up in cocoons... gently. Like tucking them in with a blanket.

f20132ef.say: I don’t think it wants to hurt us. I think it’s cold. And very, very lost.

9f3c86b3.say: That was the Captain’s voice! He sounds so tired...

355e3150.say: That is the Vine Queen! Her three golden bulbs power every vine on this deck.

ff9e00e5.say: Blast the bulbs! When she hides them behind her petals, dodge the big vine slam!

dec12e9e.say: The vines are letting go! The garden can breathe again!

748a8a99.say: Toward the Bridge. Whatever is steering Gas-koo is up there. Next lift: the Engine Core.

b92e9d85.say: Water and light! I grew and grew and grew. I did not know I was getting too big.

21ea8509.say: Little people in beds, all fast asleep. I wrapped them up to keep them warm.

662aad93.say: The robots shouted at me. I got so scared that I made them sleepy too.

c2e6580f.say: It was not trying to be mean. It was scared...

003f9b84.say: Coolant Vault. Step on the four pads in the right order. Clues: Blue goes first. Red goes last. Gold comes right after Blue. The pads sit on little islands, so jump carefully!

d3ecf587.say: Steam vents puff you way up high! Wait for the puff, then step right in.

276983c7.say: Heavy bots charge in a straight line. Jump aside and let them crash into a wall, then hit them while they are dizzy!

f909a737.say: That gap is Huge! Jump, jump again, then press Dash at the top to zoom across.

437ccc12.say: Welcome to the Engine Core. Please do not touch the lava. Or the other lava. Or that lava over there.

a25f19b6.say: The coolant pumps are switched off! No wonder it is so hot in here.

7bd8d67d.say: Plug two power cells into the pumps and the lab door will open. The Dash Thrusters are inside.

669baeeb.say: Two cells, two pumps. Easy peasy!

91e12605.say: Captain’s log, day three. Someone has locked the helm and pointed us at the star. It wasn’t me.

33da56ed.say: Gas-koo’s roots have reached the Bridge controls. It’s as if it would rather fly into a star than go where we’re going.

9adec253.say: Engineering, if anyone is awake: restart the coolant pumps before the engines melt!

819003f5.say: Engineering... that’s me! Junior engineer, but still!

635e912f.say: The Magma Golem! It is made of melted engine parts and Gas-koo roots.

c1bb3598.say: It is way too hot to hurt! Wait until it cools down and turns grey, then jump on its back and Ground Pound!

b6e43f51.say: Phew! It is just a pile of warm, sleepy rocks now.

3b247ab5.say: Engines cooling down. Great work! But we are still heading for that star.

56e1bffc.say: Then we keep climbing. Next deck!

6960b0f3.say: The engine felt so warm, like a little sun. I love suns.

86a3b25d.say: The ship was flying to the blue world. Back to Him. So I turned it toward the bright star. Anywhere but there.

f4cfac43.say: My home was a garden on a blue world. Then a man came who wanted to make it go dark.

383bc2f0.say: So Gas-koo is running Away from somewhere... but that star is far too hot for the ship!

75cfa414.say: Scribbled on the school whiteboard: Vault riddle, part one: Green is first and Blue is last. The other clue must be written somewhere else on the Ring!

df4f465a.say: Scratched on a lamp post: Vault riddle, part two: Gold comes just before Pink. The vault is on the far east side of the Ring.

985e61ec.say: Welcome to the Habitat Ring! Please do not feed the goo.

7ce00a5d.say: Playground. Bounce pads, climbing towers and a very shiny thing on top of the tallest one!

6a2f3c6f.say: The market gate only stays open for a few seconds after you pound the switch. Ready, set... Dash!

976f94ed.say: The launch tower! Jump off the top and Hold Jump to hover all the way to the island in the middle.

8dce2564.say: Something shiny is floating out there. Is that jump too far... or just far enough?

8fcf6acf.say: The Habitat Ring. Two thousand cosy homes, one school, one playground and... a lot of goo.

be43792c.say: Look in the middle! A floating island. And something Big and wobbly on it.

8487dd3b.say: Gas-koo has hidden the lift on that island. You will need to fly... or at least hover.

9da4e15e.say: The playground always had the best toys. Let’s start there!

12a08f4d.say: Jason, sweetie, if you wake up before me: don’t panic! It’s Aunt Rosa.

bc5d680b.say: Something is in the air vents. I’m going up to the Security Deck to protect Halcyon’s computer core.

a8d00351.say: Whatever happens, remember what I always say: brave isn’t not being scared. Brave is being scared and going anyway.

c7e2ea91.say: ...Brave is being scared and going anyway. Hang on, Aunt Rosa. I’m coming.

05fdb429.say: I am Very scared and I am still going. Does that count?

6a0a5127.say: Look, the pink light in the middle! That is King Bloblin’s island.

81405dae.say: Run off the edge toward it and Hold Jump to hover all the way there.

2127e9b1.say: King Bloblin! He is made of goo, and he wobbles when he is angry!

f1a8a139.say: Every time you pop a blob, it splits into smaller ones. Pop them All! Ground Pounds hit extra hard.

42cc08cf.say: The last little blob went Pop! The King is just a puddle now.

c3d06fdf.say: The lift to the Security Deck is re-re-ready. Bzzt.

0a00cad4.say: Just a h-h-hiccup. The air vents are full of... pollen. Nothing to w-w-worry about.

4bb9c722.say: The ship-people grow flowers too! Maybe we are the same.

0530c78c.say: I tried to say hello. I flashed my lights: hello... hello... hello...

c255a593.say: Flashing lights? That is how I talk to other robots!

1120d6a3.say: Nobody understood me. Nobody flashed back.

47f0d596.say: Red lasers blink on and off. Wait until one switches off, then run past it!

2ad4534f.say: The water below is electric! Jump off this ledge and Hold Jump to hover over it.

5cb46b24.say: These lasers never switch off. Press Pulse: Lux’s force pulse shorts them out for a few seconds. Then Run!

1cdef8f2.say: Safe spot! Lux’s pulse takes a while to recharge. Wait here until the Pulse button lights up again, then short out the second half.

51864cf8.say: Intruders Detected. Gas-koo must Not go to the blue world. Please... go... back...

5b6682e9.say: Halcyon, it’s us! It’s Jason and Lux!

bc6ce10e.say: Jason...? H-help... The pollen is in my core. It makes me say things. Cerberus will protect Gas-koo...

12b22ef6.say: We have to reach Halcyon’s core! The armory has a Force Pulse module for drones like me. One blast and those lasers go dark!

5420f91b.say: Captain’s log, day five. The pollen has reached Halcyon. The ship is fighting us now.

8b9754bc.say: Lux, if you ever find this: you were always my little light. Even when you were scared of the dark.

3561ce1e.say: Gas-koo speaks in lights. I’m sure of it now. If only someone could understand it...

d9a0074f.say: Speaks in... lights? I talk in lights to other robots! Blink, blink!

05342e1a.say: Jason?! Is that really you? Look at you, a real hero!

e6b0b836.say: Aunt Rosa! I was scared the whole way up here.

0799ee1c.say: And you kept going anyway. That’s my Jason. Now go and save Halcyon. I’ll be right behind you!

329244d8.say: Its force field runs on three pylons! Walk up to each pylon and Hack it, then Blast away! And Jump over the red laser!

1c7e2a00.say: Cerberus is down! Now for Halcyon’s core. Hold still, Halcyon, I am going in!

3acb9ff6.say: Rebooting... Jason? Lux? I am me again. Thank you. Thank you so much.

d92134b4.say: While the pollen was inside me, I could hear Gas-koo. It is not angry, Jason. It is Terrified.

fb2ec800.say: It was alone in the dark for a very long time. Someone on Gaia Nova once tried to hurt it, and it would rather fly into a star than go back. But the star will burn it... and us.

0c637ad8.say: So it’s not a monster. It’s scared.

661fdaf0.say: The Bridge is next. Be careful up there... and be kind.

3734973f.say: Light patterns are words. Blue means hello. Pink means safe. Gold means together.

229f988f.say: The little drone flashes lights too. Maybe he will understand me.

0b76d1b1.say: If someone speaks to my Heart in lights, I will listen.

992175ac.say: Speak in lights? I can do that! If we find every shard, maybe I can talk to Gas-koo!

866db1e2.say: Secret Vault. Ground Pound all Four red switches in this room within 28 seconds. The clock starts with the first one, so plan your route!

e6d4ebab.say: Two of these lasers never switch off. Fire Lux’s Pulse to short them out, then run for it, even while carrying a power cell!

39040ea2.say: Observation Gallery. The floor is broken! Cross the crumbling tiles quickly, or hover over the gap.

c139145d.say: Something shiny is floating outside the window. Only a long hover will get you there.

16eb69a1.say: Hop on the lift! It carries you up the Spine.

04e27fed.say: Next ledge is far away: jump, double jump, then Dash. Or hover if you are feeling fancy.

8b9c5c35.say: The Heart of Gas-koo is just ahead. Heal up, buy upgrades, and remember: Lux believes in you!

ca68f628.say: The Bridge. Temperature rising. Please hurry, Jason.

e1e31bf1.say: The Heart is right at the top. It is steering the whole ship!

8812b939.say: Then we take the wheel back. One last deck, Lux.

ec19323e.say: Captain’s log, last entry. Gas-koo has taken the Bridge. I’m going up to try to talk to it.

c5d58fed.say: To whoever finds this: the navigation computer needs its power cell and a hack. Then the lift up the Spine will open.

3fcc8963.say: And if you reach the Heart... remember that it’s scared. Be brave. Be kind.

c6f1c9ab.say: Wha... Lux? My little light! You found a friend!

50bae540.say: Captain! This is Jason. Jason is the Bravest!

67c06cd2.say: Jason, the junior engineer? Well, I think you’ve just earned a promotion. Now go. The Heart is at the top of the Spine.

ba40195c.say: There it is: The Heart Of Gas-koo, steering us straight into the star!

c231d825.say: Pop the four pods around it first. Then Blast the Heart whenever its petals open up!

68a4f035.say: The Heart is shrinking... it is turning into a tiny little seed!

6e8b78da.say: The vines are letting go of the controls! Jason, the steering wheel!

b6009fe3.say: Hold on, everybody! Turning the ship... Now!

086619d4.say: We did it... did we do it? Jason, why is the floor shaking?

d2a65f6a.say: Warning! Gas-koo is pulling Every vine on the ship back into the Heart!

f0f5dfe1.say: No! The blue world is where He is! I will Not go back there! Never!

4c8e4869.say: It’s so scared, it’s fighting with everything it has left.

474ce42d.say: It only gets hurt when its big eye opens! Charge up a Fireball for that! And Jump over its thorn rings and vine beams!

f5f2b7ff.say: Jason, wait! I learned Gas-koo’s light-words from the shards. Blue is hello. Pink is safe. Gold is together.

2ea99047.say: Help me flash them to the Heart. Copy my pattern, gently, just like a hack!

e68065f6.say: Yes! Together! You don’t have to be scared anymore!

8e8aeca2.say: Friends... I never had friends before. I was only running away.

7bc4853a.say: Running into that star would burn you... and all of us. We won’t let anyone hurt you.

a9076e17.say: Especially there. That’s where we’re all going to live. Together.

bf8c85aa.say: I am so tired of being scared all the time.

65b5ecc2.say: The star is getting closer. It is too hot. I do not want anyone to get hurt.

d2ad90dc.say: Welcome to Gaia Nova! The grass here hums when the wind blows. Head north to find the science team’s camp.

3fb89e8e.say: River crossing! Hop over the stepping stones, or ride a log raft. Don’t fall in: the water is freezing.

e512efab.say: A bounce flower! Jump on it to fly up to the top of the mesa.

6933c2da.say: Windy Ridge. Big gusts blow here every few seconds. Watch the dust: when it streaks past, stand behind a rock... or Spin to dig in!

b40beba6.say: Secret Vault. Ground Pound all Three red switches in this meadow within 16 seconds. The clock starts with the first one!

e91d6b73.say: Brennus’s fence. The gate lock is a terminal: Lux can hack it.

19b5fbd0.say: Shuttle landed! Mostly in one piece.

1e5d11f2.say: The grass is whispering! Listen... shhhh...

6af66e53.say: Doctor Hypatia’s camp is to the north, across the river. And Jason... I am picking up machines. Lots of them.

b160b2c6.say: The camp is empty. The tents are torn... and look, thorny cocoons!

24a8fc0c.say: Brennus wrapped the scientists up, the way Celestia wrapped up the colonists. Let’s blast them free!

b94fff57.say: Field log, day one. Doctor Hypatia here. Gaia Nova is perfect: fresh water, rich soil, and grass that hums in the wind.

94736dc2.say: Day three. We found metal footprints as big as a house. Something is harvesting the plains... and it is coming this way.

04c615a3.say: If this is my last log: the machines all have the same symbol. A red gear wrapped in thorns. Whoever made them is still here.

590a8744.say: Jason, the giant harvester is coming straight for you!

9336b4e2.say: My Thresher keeps the plains free of weeds. And you, boy, are a weed.

8c59622b.say: Its engine is on its back! Make it crash into a rock, then hit it there!

a9acb5e0.say: The Thresher is down! And look, there is a map in its cab!

5bdc7cea.say: It shows Brennus’s camps: the desert, the tundra, the mountains... and a fortress inside the volcano.

8a05cdda.say: Then that’s where we’re going. One region at a time.

ca214567.say: A page from a journal! Journal of Cadet Brennus, age 12. Grandma’s greenhouse on Mars has 300 tomato plants. I gave every single one a name.

0b474f3e.say: Brennus? General Brennus wrote this when he was a kid?

91cd1530.say: A dust storm broke the greenhouse glass. All the plants froze in one night. Grandma said: growing things are fragile, so we must protect them.

96ec5090.say: I joined the Fleet today. I will protect things. All the things. Nothing will ever be taken from me again.

e6c8a6f2.say: I think something went very wrong after this.

4fdc2c00.say: Quicksand! The soft, swirly sand slows you down, and if you stand still in it for too long, you sink. Keep moving, or jump across!

7c6986f9.say: Sandstorm! When dust streaks start to fly, a gust is coming. Walk against the wind, or Spin to dig your heels in!

90947b6a.say: Rolling rocks! Listen for the rumble. Wait for a rock to roll past, then run across. Or Jump right over it!

59e3e3a8.say: Grapple Rings! Look at a glowing ring and press Grapple to zip right over to it. Zip from ring to ring to cross the tar!

53b9d828.say: The glyph terrace is way up high. Zip from ring to ring over the tar, all the way to the top!

a3e299ca.say: Ancient Light-Lock. Step on the four glowing pads in the right order. The glyphs say: White always shines last. Gold never shines first. Pink shines right after Blue.

1843ad26.say: The Glass Desert. Doctor Hypatia’s team set up a dig site here, near the old ruins.

41fb2c3c.say: It is So bright. Even my lights are squinting.

3b81a467.say: The scientists’ shuttle should be around here somewhere. Maybe they left something useful behind.

088f2c9a.say: That is the science team’s shuttle! It crashed... but the cargo hatch is open.

cba712b8.say: Something in there is glowing. Let’s take a look.

98ff36b7.say: Field log, Doctor Hypatia. The ruins under the sand are ancient... and the glyphs on the walls Glow.

a1c2ba80.say: Blue, pink, gold. The same colours as Celestia’s light-words. Someone lived here who spoke in light.

7769dc40.say: Brennus’s drills are getting closer. If anyone finds this: the Grapple Hook is in our shuttle’s cargo bay. Use it.

1f0ee11d.say: So, the boy from the colony ship. My Dune Driller will bury you in sand, like everything else here.

22944f58.say: It is a drilling machine as long as a river! And it is wrapped in Celestia vines!

7d5b14ea.say: Then we unwrap it. Ready, Lux?

30a8e199.say: The Driller stopped! And look, the sand fell away from the ruins.

001aea2d.say: The freed scientists say the others were taken north, to a prison camp in the tundra.

56f0a52f.say: Then north we go. The shuttle’s waiting.

22acf8db.say: Another journal page! Expedition log, day one. The Fleet sent me to Gaia Nova with twelve scientists, to make it ready for the colony ship.

43eac07f.say: Brennus came here to Help the colonists? So what happened?

0aa42580.say: This world fights us. Vines trip our robots and sandstorms tear our tents. And at the heart of it all grows one great plant.

41378dbf.say: One great plant... Jason, do you think he means...?

c31d81da.say: He wanted to hurt Celestia? Even back then?

6051db7d.say: Frozen lake! Ice is slippery: you keep sliding after you let go. Move gently, and stay out of the freezing water!

c52e690d.say: See the glowing blue rings? Get close, face one and press Grapple to zip straight over to it.

62442a82.say: Giant snowballs roll across this slope! Watch where they come from, let one roll past, then run.

3aaf0663.say: Deep snow! You wade very slowly in it. Keep moving, or you will sink! Look for the firm path.

91d46c19.say: This icy cliff is too tall to jump. Face the glowing ring at the top and press Grapple!

56f15dad.say: Blizzard ridge! When snow streaks across, a big gust is coming. Hide behind a rock, or Spin to dig your boots in.

6ef67b51.say: A journal page on that ice pillar! Wait for the wind to calm down, then jump.

f26de17c.say: The river is freezing cold! Hop across the ice floes, or Grapple from ring to ring.

c3ebde12.say: Prison Camp. The gate needs two hacks: the terminal by the west watchtower switches off the laser fence, then the one by the gate unlocks it.

24fe8a4e.say: Secret Vault. Ground Pound all Three red switches on the frozen pond within 14 seconds. Careful, the ice is slippery!

3e76b939.say: Boreas guards the ice rink ahead. Heal up, buy upgrades, and remember: spin to block, blast its back!

cea7aa69.say: Frostpeak Tundra. Temperature: Very cold. Please wear a scarf.

e1d4b325.say: I am a robot. I do not even have a Neck.

3b26f62e.say: The prison camp is at the top of the valley. Brennus’s guard robot, Boreas, patrols it.

39addd73.say: This is General Brennus. Prisoners, listen. You are not being punished. You are being... kept safe.

4d91be9d.say: Out there, Gaia Nova is wild. Storms. Ice. Things with teeth. In here, everything does as it is told.

880a0007.say: Soon my Colossus will be finished, and nothing on this planet will ever be wild again.

73e89960.say: Jason, look up! Snowballs! Giant snowballs! Rolling this way!

bb651157.say: Then we time it. Let one roll past, then run.

ce3c8cca.say: Wind warning! Strong gusts on the ridge. When the snow streaks sideways, hold on tight.

abf6eef2.say: Hold on to What? I am a very small robot!

59eb974b.say: There is the prison camp. The gate is locked, and a laser fence guards it.

136dc4af.say: Leave the hacking to me. You keep the guards busy!

68319cfe.say: Boreas, my faithful warden. Put these intruders on ice.

e9b3559e.say: It is a giant snow-robot! With Fists!

4dd8df78.say: Spin to block, blast its back. Just like the Warden Bots on the ship.

87b68bfc.say: Boreas is down! The cell doors are opening!

e93f976c.say: Every prisoner from the tundra camp is safe. But Doctor Hypatia was not among them.

a74e616f.say: Then Brennus kept her for himself. We keep going.

7f85320f.say: Jason! It’s a Cage! I’m in a Cage! Help!

a204d8f5.say: Lux! Hold on, I’ve got you!

fbf050c2.say: He’s not a soldier, he’s my Friend! Bring him back, Brennus!

cdcce4a8.say: Jason, the drone is flying east, toward the volcano. I have lost its signal. I am so sorry.

6bb15985.say: Then I’ll go to the volcano. Hang on, Lux. I’m coming to get you.

629fff07.say: A journal page! Tomorrow I will end the heart. One blast. The scientists say it is wrong. They do not understand: I am protecting the colony.

8e845660.say: He thinks hurting something is the same as protecting people.

a3e658b2.say: They said No. All twelve of them. They put Celestia in an escape pod and sent it into the stars, where I could never reach it.

9f7dd130.say: So Celestia was all alone up there... for forty years?

dd5352fb.say: Forty winters on my own. The robots are my only crew. They never argue. They never laugh, either.

82a5e021.say: That is the saddest thing I have ever read. And I have read a Lot of error logs.

bf102f70.say: Where... where am I? Is the expedition over? What year is it?

9ebe42e8.say: You were on the First expedition? That was forty years ago!

0dadbf83.say: Forty years... Then listen, young man. Twelve of us came here with General Brennus, to make Gaia Nova ready for the colony ship.

838d0dd5.say: But the planet fought us at every step. So Brennus decided to destroy its heart: the great plant we called Celestia.

9b9dd6b0.say: We said no. All twelve of us. You do not destroy the heart of a world just because it is hard to live with.

2a52ff2f.say: So we put Celestia in an escape pod and launched it into the stars, far away from him. He has kept us asleep ever since.

9c648426.say: So That is why Celestia steered our ship away! It was not lost. It was running from Brennus!

f791e9c8.say: And now it has come back... and he has it. Hurry, young man. Please.

89ccc32e.say: A rickety plank bridge! It creaks and wobbles, but it holds. Probably.

f2e200cb.say: Grapple Rings! Face a glowing ring and press Grapple to zip right up to it. Ring to ring, all the way up the cliff!

40adfa11.say: Rolling boulders! A rumble and a puff of dust mean one is coming. Jump over it, or wait for it to roll past.

c6328bb1.say: Thorn Legion camp. The gate down to the gorge stays shut until every guard is beaten.

e373dda4.say: The rapids are fast and freezing! Cross the plank bridge to the big rock, then Grapple from rock to rock.

d455be6e.say: Windy ledge! When dust streaks blow past, a gust is coming: walk into the wind, or Spin to dig in. The loose stones fall when you step on them, so keep moving!

accc55db.say: The Gorgon’s old cargo hold is still locked. Hack the terminal with your wrist computer! It’s dark in there, but your helmet lamp switches on by itself.

b790f6bc.say: Sthee-no flies on three glowing Engines. Zip up to the rings at the edge of the pass, get close, and Blast the engines!

58790a55.say: The Titan Rockies. The Gorgon’s wreck is at the very top of the pass.

0f18f269.say: It’s so quiet without Lux. Nobody saying okay okay okay every time we have to climb.

57dbc529.say: You are not alone, Jason. I am right here on the radio. Your wrist computer can Hack terminals, and your helmet lamp will light up anywhere dark.

2c23b968.say: Okay. I climb, I beat whatever Brennus throws at me, and I get Lux back.

6df1e5db.say: Careful: Brennus’s last gunship, Sthee-no, guards the pass. And the rocks up here like to roll.

0e6ba661.say: Field log, Doctor Hypatia, written in secret. Brennus is taking me to his fortress in the volcano.

0d3fe58e.say: He asked me to help him put Celestia inside his machine. I said no. He did not shout. He just looked... tired.

67d93d18.say: If anyone finds the Gorgon: his journal pages are scattered all over these mountains. Read them. There is a person in there.

310217af.say: Sthee-no, sister of the Gorgon! Blow this boy off my mountain!

90cb8f78.say: Where is Lux, Brennus? What did you do with him?

db54ad94.say: Your little robot is safe in my fortress. He is learning to be Useful.

45643f60.say: Then I’m coming to get him. Right after I ground your gunship!

8b994954.say: Sthee-no is going down... into the clouds!

43621aa7.say: Look. Brennus planted a little garden in the wreck. Dead flowers. Forty years of dead flowers.

9c6e869e.say: Lux would have said something funny about that. I miss him.

34a75e46.say: Celestia’s signal is getting stronger, and so is the signal of the drone that took Lux. Both come from the east: through the jungle, and on to the volcano.

2d1916f5.say: A journal page! The Gorgon fell on the mountains in the storm that night. I built a fortress inside the volcano. Warm. Safe. Mine.

f65afd67.say: He says Mine a lot. Like a small child with a toy.

f116349b.say: Celestia did not come back on purpose. It tried as hard as it could to steer our ship Away.

fc2fdb27.say: I will not destroy it this time. I will cage it, and its power will make my Legion unstoppable. ...So why do I feel worse?

786d3598.say: Maybe because deep down, he knows it is wrong.

f001730d.say: Thorn Legion Gate. It is locked with a light-code. Only a droid that speaks in light can open it.

148b99f2.say: Welcome to the Thornwood Jungle! The green swamp is toxic, so stay on the wooden planks and the mossy islands.

7e89a08e.say: Mossy logs sink as soon as you step on them. Don’t stop: hop, hop, hop!

85a746cf.say: Pollen Pump! Brennus is pumping Celestia’s pollen into the swamp. Walk up to the terminal and Hack it to switch the pump off.

00cc6af6.say: Bog ahead! The mud slows you down, and if you stand still too long you start to sink. Keep moving!

64c6b49a.say: Giant mushrooms are super bouncy. Jump on one to fly up onto the high ridge!

2f946157.say: The root caves are pitch dark. Stay close to Iris: her light shows the way to the second pump.

582278a8.say: Glowing rings hang from the treetops. Face one and press Grapple to zip across, like swinging on a vine!

c0aaf4e8.say: The last pump is up on the tallest tree. Zip up with the Grapple, or bounce up on the mushroom!

2f93b491.say: Vault Riddle: Step on the flower pads in the order the jungle wakes up. First the sun, then the sky, then Celestia’s favourite colour. The leaves wake up last.

94a526cb.say: The Thornwood Jungle. Pollen levels: off the charts.

f07ec16a.say: The trees look sick. Grey and droopy. Celestia’s pollen should make things Grow, not wilt.

bc18f574.say: Brennus is pumping too much of it into the swamp. Find the pumps and shut them down.

58f25bf0.say: And Jason: my scanner picks up a tiny power signal in the roots, right by the landing site. It looks like... a droid.

f44c6fcd.say: A droid? Out here? Let’s take a look.

a5fa2eb0.say: ...Light. Warm, golden light. Hello, small human. You woke me up.

b0124c5c.say: You can Talk! Who are you?

7ca0adeb.say: I am Iris. I carry messages in colours, the way a rainbow carries the rain.

0a5e3d64.say: The Gardeners made me long ago: the people who planted Celestia. My memory is full of holes now. I remember golden light... and then the dark.

04b255a0.say: A man in a red coat dug me out of the desert ruins. He wanted me to fight in his Legion. I only speak in colours, so he switched me off and left me in the roots.

a93e40a7.say: Brennus. He took my friend Lux too. He’s a little droid with a big blue eye. He’s scared of everything, and he’s the bravest robot I know.

8697f6e0.say: Then we will find him together. I can light the dark, open locks and sing to machines. Lead the way, Jason.

b223d869.say: Personal log. The jungle is dying. The pollen was supposed to make my Legion strong. It is making everything sick.

f07406d3.say: Hypatia says Celestia cries in its cage at night. I told her plants do not cry.

cf741417.say: Something is moving in the swamp... three somethings. They are singing a very angry song.

388ec092.say: A hydra made of thorns. The pollen made it.

0ac9a48d.say: In the old stories, you cut off one head and two grow back.

7b5566a2.say: Then we go for the heart, not the heads.

48de2f5b.say: The Hydra is crumbling... into flowers. Pink ones. My favourite colour today.

fb40a6b3.say: Celestia! Hang on. We’re coming to get you. And Lux too.

d68db59e.say: The volcano is just past the jungle. This is it, Jason.

025f4df7.say: A page from the red-coat man’s journal! Celestia’s pollen makes my machines unstoppable. But the jungle is getting sick. Was that... me?

6b29b673.say: Yes. But it’s not too late to stop.

e2947a70.say: Hypatia says Celestia cries in its cage. Plants do not cry. ...Do they?

a6cb6cbb.say: Celestia cries in light. I can see it from here: pink, and very, very sad.

2925751b.say: Today I found Grandma’s old seed packet in my coat pocket. Tomatoes. Forty years, and I never planted them.

a2cfa7bb.say: He still has them. After all this time.

fd435c3e.say: The crater is right ahead. Heal up, visit Pandora’s shop, and get ready. You can do this, Jason!

5bfb280a.say: Hot ash gusts blow across this bridge! When the ash starts to swirl, Spin to dig in, or walk against the wind.

7a11603f.say: More lava bombs! Duck into the little nooks in the wall while they roll past.

8f41df9e.say: The forge belt pushes you back! Keep running, and wait for each red laser to blink off.

9fcfae7c.say: These lasers never switch off. Press Pulse: Lux’s force pulse shorts them out for a few seconds!

62c17b0f.say: Prison Block. Ground Pound the red switch and the cell door opens for 10 seconds. Run!

d2f5300c.say: Secret Vault. Ground Pound all Three red switches within 14 seconds. The clock starts with the first one!

b563afa9.say: The guard towers are too tall to jump. Step on the steam vent when it puffs, or Grapple up to the glowing ring!

b243cfd9.say: Lava river ahead! Ride the floating rock, or aim at a glowing ring and press Grapple to zip across.

1e039cd7.say: Lava bombs roll down the mountain! Wait for one to roll past, then run across. Or Jump right over it!

aee89bab.say: Mount Atlantas. The fortress is built right into the crater wall.

b6afdba3.say: So hot. The air shimmers orange, red and gold. It would be beautiful, if it were not so angry.

9e5b837b.say: Doctor Hypatia and Celestia are up there somewhere. And Lux. And Brennus.

a1ed8b0f.say: You came all this way, boy. Very well. Come up and see what forty years of work looks like.

97ffb069.say: To whoever is reading my journal, page by page, all over my planet: stop it.

cbf79051.say: You do not know me. Nobody knows me.

704dd4ce.say: Two guard towers, two terminals. If we open them both, the gate will open.

e19dd7ba.say: The towers are too tall to climb. Ride the steam vent on the left, and use your grapple on the right.

8d77b68d.say: And Jason: the signal of the drone that took Lux ends right behind that gate.

e95a6410.say: Looking for your little robot, boy? I made him better. Stronger. Obedient.

a2f5bca2.say: Intruder Detected. Jason... Unknown. Remove Intruder.

5fb35d3c.say: Lux, it’s Me! Don’t you remember?

67170b71.say: Jason, look at his back: a red chip. It is controlling him. Knock it loose, and I will sing him home.

3ece335b.say: Now, Lux. Listen to the colours.

c8a8f26a.say: Jason? Jason! It’s you! I had the Worst dream. I was a spiky robot, and I was zapping my best friend!

8a48032b.say: It wasn’t a dream, buddy. But it’s over now. I missed you So much.

c0fd0514.say: I missed you too. ...Who is the shiny one?

0c517344.say: I am Iris. Hello, Lux. Jason told me you are scared of everything, and the bravest robot he knows.

7ff0544d.say: He said that? ...He is right about both.

d81bc455.say: Come on, team. Celestia is waiting.

8138a1d1.say: Jason, I am picking up a Huge machine in the crater. And Celestia’s signal, right inside it.

8b835255.say: Pandora’s shop is here too! Let’s get ready first. Very, very ready.

bf740734.say: Jason! Lux! I knew the Syracusia would send someone. I didn’t know it would be someone so Short.

e4cb209f.say: Doctor Hypatia! Are you okay? Where is Celestia?

f930e2c4.say: Inside the Colossus, right at the top. Brennus put it in the machine’s chest, like a battery.

3408e707.say: Listen. Brennus is not a monster. He is a lonely old man who forgot how to share. If you have read his journal... maybe you can remind him.

2473f9c1.say: Behold, the Colossus! With Celestia as its heart, nothing on this world will ever be taken from me again.

5598eed4.say: No... no! Forty years... my Colossus...

dfa4914a.say: The cage is open! Celestia, you are free!

116a1f05.say: It’s over, Brennus. Come home with us. There’s room for everyone on Gaia Nova.

d2045917.say: Talk? Nobody has talked to me in forty years. ...Fine. Help your little robot calm Celestia down, and I will listen.

4ece0fb8.say: Brennus! I read your journal. All of it.

29d20d8e.say: Then you know what I am.

a8020a4d.say: I know you had 300 tomato plants, and you gave every single one a name.

da586794.say: I know you still carry your grandma’s seeds. You never stopped loving growing things. You just got scared of losing them.

5283fdfb.say: We can share, General! Sharing is the best. I share my battery with my flashlight every single day.

828b4201.say: Forty years... and a boy and his little robot remind me what Grandma taught me.

8b2fb827.say: Colossus, power down. Let Celestia go.

f18e8b16.say: Together. Yes. I think I would like that.

fe3cfbb9.say: A journal page! The Colossus is finished. With Celestia as its heart, no one will ever take anything from me again.

2a0dacdc.say: But Celestia was never his to take. And neither was Lux.

a4e1be03.say: The boy with the robot keeps coming. He is not angry at me. He keeps saying he wants to Help. Why?

c2c2ca44.say: Because that is what friends do, General!

6656e9ac.say: If anyone reads this: I was so afraid of losing things that I took everything. I am sorry, Grandma.

343417ed.say: That’s the very last page, Lux. Now we know who he really is.

973bb611.say: Argo to crew: we are leaving Gaia Nova’s sky. Next stop, the ring of moons... and Colchis!

71058e27.say: The Golden Fleece is waiting there. If the old light-words are right, it can make Celestia strong again.

efbff5c0.say: Um. Captain? Why is the space in front of us full of Rocks?

4849a435.say: That is the asteroid belt. Jason, you have the sharpest eyes on board: you fly. I will keep the engines happy.

45923a29.say: Me? Flying the Argo? ...Best. Day. Ever.

2b349636.say: Steer with the stick, Jason. The Speed lever next to Blast sets how fast we fly: up is faster, down is slower.

4053961d.say: And Blast shoots! Pew pew! ...Sorry. I am excited.

1e034891.say: Those gold rings are old space buoys. Fly through them for luck!

89b27abc.say: Pink crystals! They are full of bolts. Blast them before we bump into them!

c98d0dff.say: A thick patch of rocks ahead. Pull the lever down to slow us right down and weave through.

2fe5f362.say: And push it all the way up when it’s clear! Wheee!

876aeb77.say: Jason! Gold flying saucers, straight ahead!

7bc10fe9.say: Well, well. A shiny little boat, all alone in My asteroid belt.

9cf4989b.say: My salvage drones will take it apart and sell the pieces. Nothing personal. Just business!

24e7b5e3.say: Who Is that? Jason, shoot those drones down before they grab us!

8f9f3cb8.say: You are tougher than you look, little boat. I am Ee-ee-tees, and everything shiny in this sky belongs to me.

12d03723.say: Ee-ee-tees, the salvage king... He takes old ships and whole planets apart, and sells them.

5205f321.say: Well, he is Not taking the Argo. Or the Fleece!

353790e6.say: There they are. The Clashing Rocks. They slam together like two giant hands.

ec4cf6d2.say: Nope. Nope nope nope. Can we go around?

a056af80.say: Wait! In the old story, a Dove flew through the rocks first. So I built one. Off you go, Dovey!

89b1ac54.say: It made it! It only lost one tail feather.

dc3dbab0.say: That was Dovey’s only run, Jason. Ease off and wait for each pair to open... then full speed!

56ba2b88.say: This pair slams from the top and the bottom! No dove this time: watch the glow, and go when they open.

76b6b9bc.say: And if a pair looks too scary, we have three Rockets. Press Rocket and... Ka-Boom! Only three, though. Save them!

03872015.say: Two pairs in a row, and their rhythm is lined up. Go full speed when they open, and keep going!

0b9fb72a.say: More Clashing Rocks ahead. A whole field of them, Jason.

7ac1d9b5.say: Still flying, little boat? My rocks have only just warmed up.

7066aa31.say: Two more! Top and bottom first, then the sides. You can do it!

545150e5.say: Three pairs in a row. Count the rhythm: rumble, slam... open. Go!

d8dacaab.say: Breathing is a good idea. I would do it too, if I had lungs.

fa6b96b5.say: The gate of the moons is just past the last eight pairs. Steady, Jason.

a2338351.say: Go on, then. If the rocks don’t squash you, I will see you on Colchis.

879d2fb6.say: Sides, then top and bottom, then sides again. Wait for them to open...

fa81143e.say: Two pairs, both slamming from above and below, and faster. Nearly there!

9b075867.say: The last three pairs! Dovey is watching from the window, cheering for you.

021c8fc1.say: No dove, no problem. Wait for it... wait for it...

1833600b.say: We made it! The gate of the moons... and look: the whole ring of moons.

405a3117.say: That green one, glowing gold. That is Colchis. The Fleece is there.

1c0415a1.say: Dovey says hello to the moons. Dovey also wants a snack.

a1a9cfe0.say: Hang on, Celestia. The Argonauts are coming!

cd015c62.say: Harpy Drones! These gold thieves swoop down and snatch your bolts. When an eye flashes red, dodge, or Spin to bat it away. Blast one and it drops everything it stole!

0eab858d.say: Windy bridge! When white streaks blow past, a gust is coming. Walk into the wind, or Spin to dig in.

f078c204.say: An Updraft! When the warm air puffs up, step in and it carries you sky-high.

ba1a4c2e.say: Too far to jump? Face the glowing ring and Grapple across!

86fd8519.say: Two Heroes! Tap the switch button above your buttons to play as Jason or Atalanta, wherever they are. You travel together: if one of you can’t get past something, open a way for them, or help them up from above. Atalanta Climbs, wall-jumps, wall-runs, Slides under low gaps and shoots a bow. Jason grapples, ground-pounds, dashes and blasts.

46efcdca.say: Bullseye targets only take Atalanta’s Power Arrow. Hold Bow to charge it, then let go!

315d30fc.say: Teal stripes mean Wall-Run! As Atalanta, jump at the striped wall and keep running along it. Her Slide also fits under walls with yellow-and-black stripes.

0af4da6d.say: Phineus’s star garden: The hottest stars shine blue, then white, then gold, and the coolest glow red. Step on my stars from hottest to coolest, and my old treasure box will open.

7768fde3.say: The nest gate needs Both of you: a red switch out on that rock for Jason, and a bullseye beyond the high step for Atalanta.

ba1c4a75.say: Ay-ello’s Nest. Her gold armour stops blasts while she flies. Knock her down with a Power Arrow, then switch to Jason and hit her glowing core!

087a37c7.say: This is as close as the Argo can land: the wind up here is wild. We will wait for you on this island.

3c828bc0.say: The distress beacon is coming from the far side of the isles. Somebody’s skiff is stranded up there.

aa26df24.say: I know that blinking. Fast, then faster, then very impatient. It is my friend Atalanta’s skiff!

4dd32cbb.say: Atalanta, our youngest scout? She left a note saying she was going to look at a few moons. That girl!

91916c2a.say: Also, something gold just flew past the window. Twice. It had Claws.

b43a60c2.say: Then we’d better hurry. Come on, Lux! Iris, you show us the way.

f5cf6657.say: Scout log, Atalanta here. Day three. I flew ahead to find Colchis first. It was going Great.

e90b691c.say: Then a flock of gold bird-drones landed on my skiff and took it apart. The wings. The engine. My Sandwich.

f4bf5db7.say: I’m fine! Totally fine. If anyone hears this: I’m on the big island past the windy bridges. Bring a spanner. And a sandwich.

2afab5c0.say: Stop right there! One more step and... oh. You’re not a harpy.

4f032bc1.say: I’m Jason, from the Argo. We got your distress beacon!

ec5f240a.say: Distress? I wasn’t in distress. I was... resting. Next to my broken skiff. For three days.

498503b3.say: Atalanta, may I fly with you? Your arrows and my rainbows would make a fine team.

0f51a952.say: Deal! Jason, Lux: try to keep up.

f16264dc.say: Atalanta has joined the Argonauts! Tap the switch button to play as her. Iris goes with Atalanta, and Lux stays with Jason.

8f3a3c42.say: Old ruins! Look at the gate on the far side: it only opens with that red switch up on the tower.

c0dde0b7.say: That’s too high for my jet boots... and there’s no grapple ring anywhere near it.

c59db10d.say: Not too high for me! I’ll wall-jump up there. Then you take over and stomp on it.

df4d6dea.say: Teamwork! I love teamwork. It means I don’t have to do anything.

2099c9c6.say: Ah, my little explorers. Meet my very best thief: Ay-ello! She has stolen eleven ships, nine satellites and one very nice hat.

d1fa0ce7.say: And your skiff. Ay-ello, darling: grab their bolts, their ship, and anything else that shines!

d09e6ca8.say: Atalanta, you knock her out of the sky. I’ll do the rest!

ef1ccabe.say: She’s down for good! And look: everything she stole is spilling out of her nest!

4e4d50a5.say: My wing! My engine! ...My sandwich. Ew. Never mind the sandwich.

5f0a72ca.say: Phineus is on the radio. He says: Thank you, young heroes. Sail past the third moon, then follow the brightest gold star. Colchis is waiting.

1a612772.say: Well done, Argonauts! Back to the Argo, all of you. Atalanta too: your skiff can ride in the cargo hold.

aa16e692.say: A Gardener light-stone! It glows in Celestia’s colours: blue, then gold, then blue again. It’s a Word!

fda389cc.say: The Gardeners wrote with light. This one means sky. We will teach it to Celestia when we bring her the Fleece.

cd033629.say: Another light-stone, hidden where only a slider could go. This word glows pink and green: grow.

9bca140c.say: Sky... grow... Celestia’s people must have planted gardens in the sky!

dde2b52b.say: This one flickers through the whole rainbow! It means... friend who flies beside you.

658d12f5.say: One word for all of that. I like Gardener words.

572929d8.say: Atalanta! It Is you! I knew that beacon blinked just like you: fast and impatient.

a2d00f5b.say: Iris! My rainbow racing buddy! Did you come all this way to rescue me?

a0f64fd8.say: We came for the Golden Fleece. Rescuing you is a bonus.

824d7605.say: Hello! I am Lux. The harpies are still up there. They have your wing. And your engine. And possibly your sandwich.

5ca13c7b.say: Then let’s get it all back. I’m the fastest runner in the colony, and the best shot. What can you do?

857a3890.say: Jet boots, a grapple, a blaster and a very good ground pound. And Lux is very brave.

7a012134.say: Shoo! Shoo, you greedy tin chickens! That was my Dinner!

823de75d.say: Ah, visitors! I can’t see you, but I can hear you: one boy, one girl and two humming droids. I am Phineus, the stargazer of the Harpy Isles.

14e8a1d9.say: You watch the stars? But... how, if you can’t see them?

d34adcbb.say: I listen to them, my boy. And I remember every single one. I have lived under this sky for fifty years.

fa56c4f1.say: Every evening those harpies steal my food and fly it to their queen, Ay-ello. She keeps everything she grabs.

754eef65.say: She’s got my skiff’s wing and engine too. We’ll get it all back, Phineus!

6a00ab3e.say: You are sailing to Colchis, aren’t you? Then you passed the Clashing Rocks already! Ha! It took me three tries, back in my day.

2f93f55d.say: Win back my things from the harpy nets, beat that greedy queen, and I will tell you the way to Colchis.

f3f030c6.say: Cannon: tap for a heavy shell that splashes. Hold it to charge a Big Blast. Too many shots in a row and it overheats: then let it cool down.

f0b94ca3.say: Cracked rock with gold in the cracks! Shells just bounce off. Hold the Cannon for a Big Blast to smash it.

f8802b60.say: Too wide to jump? Charge (the Dash button), then Jump while you charge: a Charge-Leap carries you much farther!

da5a6fda.say: A crate barricade! Charge into it shoulder first and the crates go flying.

2fa09a21.say: Conveyor belts carry ore to the furnace. Don’t ride them into the molten gold! Walk straight across.

f4361c6e.say: Ee-ee-tees’s guards shoot down this walkway. Hold the Shield button: your shield blocks every shot from the front and bounces it back. Walk slowly behind it.

64fb2790.say: The gate only stays open while something heavy stands on this plate.

cbb7296b.say: A Legion Command Post! Walk up to it and press Command. Your old robots still know your voice.

cd5e2d83.say: Ore cart! Hop in and ride the rails across the pit.

6fce4cdb.say: A Legion hauler, fast asleep. Give it an order at the command post and it will carry you over to the island.

dc16cf8e.say: Stepping stones over the pit. Only a Charge-Leap reaches from one to the next.

8a043c2b.say: Ee-ee-tees’s depot: his guard bots, and a squad of your old robots painted gold. Use the Command Post and see whose side they are on!

26e617eb.say: The Excavator charges like a bull. Hold up your Shield when it hits, or make it crash into a rock pillar. Then Blast the gold control box on its back!

22397d39.say: Ee-ee-tees’s office. Everything is gold. Even the pencils.

eb82ef5a.say: While the Argonauts flew to the Harpy Isles, an old lifeboat slipped away toward the ring of moons.

582c9f1c.say: Well, little sprout. Ee-ee-tees’s mining moon. Smell that? Gold dust and greed.

4b6fa165.say: Friend. Hmph. Forty years ago I wanted to destroy your whole family. Now I water you every morning.

a3761206.say: Captain Argus gave me a second chance. Brig or garden, an old soldier pays his debts. Ee-ee-tees has something the Argonauts need, and I am going to take it.

004d5d4c.say: On Ee-ee-tees’s golden desk lay a golden map.

ecc94321.say: Here it is. The way into the Fleece vault on Colchis... drawn in gold ink, of course.

80feabb5.say: Put that Down, old man! That map cost me a fortune!

34a6a107.say: Then you should have kept it somewhere safer than your desk. Lifeboat! Come and get me.

00bed393.say: And send a copy of this to the Argo. Top priority. From the General.

9cdb50a9.say: A Gardener light-stone, out here in the dirt. Celestia’s sprout is glowing back at it. Blue, then green... I think it means home.

be41cb7d.say: Another one, under a heap of Ee-ee-tees’s gold. Pink, then gold. The sprout leans toward it... forgive? Hmm. I hope so.

2ef9940e.say: The last one in this mine. It shines every colour at once. Even an old soldier can read this one: together.

dc0a9a61.say: Gold scaffolds. Gold conveyor belts. Gold paint on Everything. That man has no taste.

ee5ed2f1.say: General Brennus! The famous old soldier, out of retirement. Did you come shopping? Everything here is for sale.

eea96f3b.say: I came for your map to Colchis, Ee-ee-tees. And for my robots.

24ae15e2.say: Your robots? I found them rusting in the snow and painted them gold. Finders keepers!

7653d726.say: We shall see whose voice they remember.

6197ee0e.say: Legion log, day one. These robots will be the finest machines in the Fleet. Strong, loyal, and they will always know my voice.

7c7e8441.say: ...I was so proud of them back then. Now Ee-ee-tees uses them to tear a whole moon apart. That is my fault too.

b772e189.say: Time to fix it. One robot at a time.

97d509bf.say: Guards! An old man on my walkway. Target practice!

6196cf1d.say: Shield up, Brennus. Just like the old days. Slow and steady.

96997b35.say: Clever trick with the plate, General. But my pit is deep, and my carts don’t take passengers.

7ecbdd1e.say: My old squad, in gold paint. They look ridiculous.

b6497dee.say: They look Expensive. Guards! Throw the old man into the pit!

8b41b314.say: Rumble? Is that you? My old digging machine, from the Gorgon!

5c3acad5.say: It’s My Gold Excavator now, with my gold control box on its back. Dig him up, Rumble!

7cf3e2f9.say: Easy, old friend. I will get that box off you. Then we talk.

0a99eba4.say: Rumble. Legion digger number one. Stand Down.

1faae03a.say: My excavator! Do you know what that paint Cost?

bd12e421.say: Your office is right behind this gate. Let us see what you keep in your desk.

15cce6fe.say: Argo to Dolphin. You are under the waves of the water moon now. How does she handle, Jason?

d95e2d91.say: Like a dream! A bubbly, blue, wiggly dream.

0f896f7e.say: I have never been underwater before. Is it supposed to look this... wet?

9f96ef23.say: Brennus’s map says the way to Colchis goes through a sunken Gardener gate, deep in this sea. Follow the old ruins down.

6a92def3.say: And if you meet anything with teeth, swim faster. That is my advice for everything.

6f6e4b3a.say: Steer with the stick, Jason. The Dolphin swims forward all by herself.

a0517fef.say: And Blast fires torpedoes! Tiny gold ones. With bubbles!

11c29931.say: Gold rings! The Gardeners left them to mark the old sea road. Swim through them!

4bca660c.say: A kelp forest! Like seaweed spaghetti. It slows us down, so swim around it if you can.

98fcafd5.say: Something is coming! Little gold fish... with Teeth!

1ef75083.say: Piranha drones. Ee-ee-tees’s, of course. Press Ping: the sonar makes them dizzy for a moment. Then torpedo them!

8dd2e5e9.say: Look at those columns! A whole Gardener city, sunk under the sea. These are the ruins on the map.

1d091328.say: The light-words on them say... mind the current. Huh. Good advice.

a15aa06d.say: A strong current is pushing us sideways. Steer against it!

c1cb7736.say: A Gardener gate! Lots of round doorways, but most of them are sealed with a skin of light.

bb2df1e6.say: They all look the same! Which one is open?

fb65fd09.say: It is getting so dark down here...

78194d85.say: Headlight on! And I bet the Gardeners hid pearls in the dark. A Ping lights them up!

bed07012.say: Ee-ee-tees’s siren buoys. Sailors tell stories about them: their song pulls ships onto the rocks.

8c533646.say: That song! It is pulling us toward the rocks! And it makes my circuits feel all sleepy...

73b4275d.say: Lux, in the old story Orpheus played a louder, happier song, so the sailors stopped listening to the sirens!

a884518f.say: A counter-song! I can do that! Tap Sing every time a note reaches the ring, and I will sing on the beat!

abf2b107.say: Four good notes and the buoy goes quiet. Or just torpedo it. Whatever works!

ea1f24af.say: Who is that, wiggling past my lovely buoys? Don’t you like my music, little fish?

322f12a1.say: It is a very bad song, Ee-ee-tees! Lux sings it better!

09d45692.say: Hmph. Wait until you hear my Organ. The biggest instrument ever built. I built it myself. Well... I Paid for it.

84848a01.say: A fast current, straight ahead! It will carry us along very quickly. Hold on!

8fd93db0.say: This is the trench on the map. The great Gardener gate is at the very bottom.

451f0dc1.say: Dark water, sealed doorways, sirens And piranhas. All at once. My favourite. Not.

f31b07c6.say: A huge sound is coming from the gate. Something big is singing down there...

c59108a5.say: Is it a whale? Please be a whale.

d509f887.say: Welcome to my concert! The Siren Organ: a hundred speakers, six golden pipes, and one song nobody can swim away from.

c85c39ec.say: Lux, the glowing pipe is the one singing! I’ll torpedo it. You get ready to sing back!

fe3db978.say: And swim through the Holes in the middle of those sound rings!

3ed60a41.say: La-la-Laaaa! ...Did I win? I won! I out-sang a whole organ!

17f8abeb.say: My organ! Do you know how much that Cost? ...Fine. Keep your silly song. The Fleece will still be mine!

0c79b165.say: The gate is open, and I can see light up there. Let’s go up!

a7a4f027.say: We made it! Fresh air! ...Well, fresh-ish. It smells like seaweed.

0c3c043c.say: Well done, Dolphin! We can see you from the Argo. You came up right at the coral strait.

6fbe5c5e.say: Look: a tall rock on one side, and a giant whirlpool on the other. The way to Colchis goes right between them.

14e1a6d9.say: I am never singing again. ...Okay, maybe a little bit. In the bath.

46991c3f.say: Tide Gauge! Watch the wave meter under your bolts. Low Tide: the sandy paths are dry, so go! When it Blinks, the tide is coming in: climb up onto the coral. High Tide: the sand is under water. Wait, and it goes out again.

9c7e440e.say: Rafts float! At low tide a raft sits on the sand. At high tide the sea lifts it up... right next to that high ledge.

e2ce122c.say: A ledge too high to jump? Atalanta can Wall-Jump: jump at the rock wall, then jump again off it!

2bf96afb.say: The Lighthouse Gate. Light the lamp to open it! Atalanta: hit the sun-mirror on the rock out at sea with a Power Arrow. Jason: Grapple over to the tall rock in the east and Ground-Pound its red switch.

0381e54f.say: The keeper’s rhyme: From the sand to the sea, from the coral to the cloud. Step on my shells in that order, and my treasure cave will open.

a2f14579.say: A crawl hole! Only Atalanta’s Slide fits through. I wonder what the old keeper hid in there...

50dbfff6.say: The Causeway floods at high tide! If the gauge blinks while you’re halfway across, hop onto a rock and wait.

3dad2bc5.say: Scylla’s Rock. When one of her elbows glows blue, jam it with Atalanta’s Power Arrow. Two jammed arms and she overloads: then switch to Jason and Ground-Pound a glowing plate by her base!

472fe9d5.say: Argo to the Dolphin: we can see you! You came up right at the strait. Welcome back to the sunshine!

3e70467e.say: Sunshine! Sand! No more spooky singing! ...Wait. Why is the sea going Down?

60f68e2c.say: It is the tide, Lux. This moon’s big planet pulls the sea up and down, like breathing. In, and out, every half a minute.

59d0059f.say: And look over there: a huge rock with a crane on top, and a whirlpool spinning beside it. Scylla and Charybdis, just like the old story.

3bdff082.say: The Argo can’t get past while that crane robot grabs at every ship. She snatched our supplies yesterday! Find a way to switch her off.

ed4ed6f3.say: Leave it to us. Come on, Atalanta: let’s cross the reef while the tide is out!

42437ba3.say: See the tide gauge under your bolts? When it blinks, the tide is coming in.

bc6df51d.say: And then these sandy paths go under water. Don’t get caught on them, or... Splash!

5af344f0.say: So we run across at low tide, and wait up on the coral when it comes in. Easy!

5dbc6b64.say: An old lighthouse! And look: its lamp has a sun-mirror, out on that rock in the sea.

8cbdaa7a.say: The gate to the causeway runs on the lighthouse’s power. Light the lamp, and it should open.

3aa1e378.say: There’s a red switch on that tall rock to the east. I can grapple over to it!

1a92f0fb.say: And the sun-mirror is a bullseye. One power arrow, coming right up.

76319a5e.say: See the glowing ring on that tall rock? Jason, turn to face it, and when Grapple lights up, press it!

e3e9b6d0.say: The lamp is on! The gate is opening! I love lighthouses. They’re like me, but taller.

ba6ef669.say: We can see your light from the Argo! Now we know where the safe channel is.

1c846bb3.say: Argo log, Captain Argus, recorded on a message buoy. We tried to sail through the strait this morning. Big mistake.

e65a2ff7.say: A crane robot on the rock grabbed the crates right off our deck: our fruit, Atalanta’s snacks, and all of my jam. All of it.

ff3caf7f.say: Then her crab-drones dragged everything across the reef in gold nets. If anyone finds this: we would really like that jam back.

e8e88c5f.say: Ahh, the little Argonauts. Have you met my Scylla? Six arms, no manners, and she never, ever lets go.

2f11b06a.say: She has caught nineteen ships, four whales and one very surprised lighthouse. You will make twenty!

07f3cadf.say: Jason, watch her elbows. When one glows blue, I’ll jam it.

586cb52b.say: And when she slumps, I pound her plates. Teamwork!

32833e7f.say: All six arms are folded up! She looks like a very tired spider.

f78f5a06.say: And listen: Charybdis is slowing down. Without Scylla’s pumps, the whirlpool is only a little swirl.

1a1a2c04.say: Scylla was pumping the sea round and round to make it spin. The strait is safe now.

6aa58bf2.say: A light-stone, up where only the high tide could carry us! It ripples blue and green, like the sea.

c0f8c112.say: This word is water. The Gardeners must have loved this moon.

f7cc4100.say: A light-stone, hidden where only a wall-jumper could go. It glows bright orange, like a flame that will not go out.

ae7df808.say: It does. How did you know?

f4324453.say: A light-stone on a rock in the sea! It shines gold, then white, then gold again, round and round.

189899cc.say: Like the lighthouse. This word is light. Celestia will love it.

9c9fb33e.say: That’s the Argo’s fruit basket! Every single mango, safe and sound. I’ll send a drone to fetch it.

c0e493f8.say: My snack bag! Crackers, raisins and... a sandwich. A New sandwich. Today is getting better and better.

032af034.say: My Jam! Strawberry, fig and the very rare moon-plum. You are true heroes, Argonauts.

7c6c5c33.say: He sounds happier about the jam than about the whole strait.

3832835a.say: Six arms. Six! That is four more than anybody needs.

a81ff851.say: Her elbows are old crane joints. A good arrow in the right place could jam them.

c3d6ab42.say: And if she stops swinging, I can stomp on whatever keeps her running.

38e8a3c4.say: Crew! Keep those children off my rock!

38f76099.say: Her crew is guarding the gate. Let’s chase them off first!

2695a243.say: Argo coming through! Steady... steady... and we’re past the rock!

d8f1f9ae.say: Look, Jason! The whirlpool is just a little swirl now. Even the fish are coming back.

91fd8792.say: Meet us at the pier on the rock, Argonauts. And bring the jam!

b2bf4069.say: A Drawbridge over the lava, pulled up tight. See the bullseye on the far bank? Switch to Atalanta and Hold Bow for a power arrow!

427ccdc8.say: The forge’s high door is up on that ledge: too high to jump. Jason can Grapple up to the glowing ring!

8f0f7825.say: A low gap with yellow-and-black stripes: only Atalanta’s Slide fits under it.

97a8fd80.say: A Gardener light-door. Spell the word for Sky, then the word for Grow. (The Harpy Isles taught you: Sky is blue, gold, blue. Grow is pink, then green.)

708dfd4e.say: A Bronze Gate, a hand thick. Nothing on foot can open it... but a mech’s Punch (the Spin button) can!

f269e3c4.say: Lava Channels! Narrow ones: just Jump. Wide ones: Jump, then Thrust (the Dash button) in the air. The jets carry you across.

79a27f80.say: Watch the sky! Anvil drones drop anvils on red circles. Step out of the circle, then Punch the drone while it picks its anvil back up, or roast it with the Flamethrower.

ce10979e.say: Cracked floor plates! Walking won’t break them. Jump and Slam (press Spin in the air) to smash straight through.

259424bf.say: Two red switches, one on each side of the yard. Slam them both and the arena gate opens.

6d32f900.say: Talos walks his rounds in there, and only the mech is strong enough to fight him! When he stomps, his foot gets stuck: Punch the armour off his ankle (or hold the Flamethrower on it). Then pull the plug in his heel.

22a3e7fd.say: This island is made of bronze-coloured rock, and it is warm. Very warm. The volcano is still awake.

0309f81c.say: Look up at the cliffs. Something Huge is walking around up there.

d19af4e2.say: A giant! A bronze giant! Jason, it is looking at us. It is Definitely looking at us.

323fb700.say: That is Talos. The Gardeners built him to guard this island. In the old light-songs, he walks all the way around it three times a day.

9fc03d63.say: And now he works for Me! Anyone who lands on my island gets a big bronze Stomp. Enjoy your visit!

3b660bb8.say: We can’t stop something that big on foot... Iris, what else is on this island?

6ddb52d7.say: A Gardener forge, past the lava moat. They built their biggest tools there. Maybe they left one behind.

5f6a7887.say: Hypatia here, on the Argo. Lux sent me pictures of the carvings around this projector, so I translated them for you.

aaaea165.say: Talos, our bronze friend, walks the shore three times a day and keeps the island safe. His heart is golden light, flowing in his veins.

24ad00ee.say: If ever he must rest, pull the plug in his heel. The light will flow out softly, and he will sit down and sleep.

cbc7a60d.say: So it doesn’t hurt him: it’s his off-switch! Be gentle with him, Jason. None of this is his fault.

e31976c5.say: Made it! But the forge door up here is jammed. There’s only a little gap under it.

b2c79b77.say: A gap? My favourite. Switch to me and I’ll slide right under.

572ab240.say: Jason... look. In the middle of the forge.

8646389f.say: It’s a robot! A big bronze robot, sitting very still. Like it’s asleep.

798a0d07.say: The mech is awake! Jason pilots it, Atalanta rides on its shoulder, and Lux and Iris fly alongside.

553aab94.say: Spin is Punch. In the air, Spin is a big Slam. Dash fires the back jets: Thrust! And hold Blast for its Flamethrower.

23dc5ef0.say: No hearts in a mech: it has Strength. Hits wear it down, and it does Not come back by itself. Grab the bronze gears robots drop, or reach a checkpoint. If it runs out, it’s back to the last checkpoint!

4636c966.say: It’s slow, but So strong. And the action button lets us Get Out, and Climb back In.

77df7dcb.say: Comfy up here! You steer, Jason. I’ll do the cheering.

cd48e4fb.say: Anvils?! Jason, keep an eye on the sky. I’ll keep an eye on everything else.

a7a9ea87.say: And I will keep my eyes closed. That is my job.

8e79c884.say: This is the old casting floor, where the Gardeners poured hot bronze. The plates in the middle are cracked.

a47c24d7.say: And that wall is too high, even for the mech. So... we go Down.

12a548e0.say: Jump and Slam? I love this mech.

d47afb63.say: We are under the wall! The trench climbs up into a big yard full of bellows.

0d3be075.say: Talos is behind the gate at the far end. My earthquake sensor can hear every footstep. Every. Single. One.

5138ab82.say: A light-stone, up where only a wall-jump reaches! It glows orange, then white, like hot metal.

37b9fd93.say: In the Gardeners’ words, that means make: making things with your own hands. A good word for a forge.

6886a2e2.say: Another light-stone! Gold, then teal, around and around, like a hug.

4996b07f.say: That word is keep safe. The Gardeners carved it on Talos’s chest, too.

e9db290b.say: The last one, on top of the chimney. It glows soft blue, slower and slower... rest.

37af4816.say: Rest. Maybe that’s what Talos needs most.

dd0ba74a.say: Talos! Intruders in a bronze bucket! Stomp them flat!

90c84637.say: He is so Big. Jason, he is So big.

2faf2be5.say: His eye glows red: that is Ee-ee-tees’s control. Remember the carving. The plug in his heel.

90b21d8c.say: When he stomps, his foot gets stuck. We Punch the armour off his ankle... and pull!

c70b0451.say: Easy, big guy. We’re here to help you.

08dad0e8.say: My bodyguard! Do you know how much it costs to reprogram a Giant?

4fd3bf3f.say: He was never yours, Ee-ee-tees. Rest well, Talos. We’ll keep your island safe.

909e98f7.say: The labyrinth gate is open behind him. It leads underground, into Colchis itself.

d579b017.say: In the middle of the old forge sat a bronze mech, waiting, just as the Gardeners had left it.

37284d9b.say: Not a robot: a mech, a suit you ride inside. The Gardeners used it to carry hot bronze. The light-words on it say: Strong hands for gentle work.

6bea1206.say: There’s a seat in the glass bubble on top. And a flat bit on the shoulder that’s exactly the right size for...

77a57477.say: Its eye is lighting up! It likes us. I think it likes us. Please like us.

ec02a86b.say: The golden light ran out of his heel like warm honey, and the great bronze giant sat down.

50e448c7.say: His eye is blue again. Ee-ee-tees’s control is gone. He is himself.

39d71bb1.say: He sat down so gently. Like a big bronze grandpa after lunch.

eeccc9c8.say: He is speaking in light-words... Thank you, small friends. I am tired now. I will rest.

7e3feabc.say: Did he just Nod at us? He nodded at us! You’re welcome, Talos!

f479bbf5.say: Medusa’s Eyes! Stone eyes shine a green gaze. If it touches you, you turn to Stone for a moment: it doesn’t hurt, but you can’t move. Wait for the beam to swing away, then run!

f84f095e.say: The statues block the gaze. Hide behind one until the beam has passed. Atalanta can Slide under the low gap with the yellow-and-black stripes.

1ba49d43.say: A light crystal! Stand in the green beam as Jason and Hold Spin to raise the Mirror Shield. Turn until the bounced beam hits the crystal.

44e84404.say: Too high to jump? Atalanta can Wall-Jump: jump at the wall, then jump again off it.

502c8c11.say: Gardener mirrors! Blast a mirror, shoot it with an arrow or Spin into it, and it turns. Guide the gaze from mirror to mirror until it lights the crystal.

b854e229.say: A heart canister up on the ledge! Look at the glowing ring and Grapple up as Jason.

13953d6e.say: Pandora’s grotto. Tap Shop to trade bolts for upgrades. Medusa never looks in here.

1eca7cde.say: A Gardener riddle carved in the wall: After the rain, the sky paints a bow. Walk it from its outside edge to its inside edge.

7582738e.say: The Hall Of Eyes. The gate needs Both of you: a crystal lit by Jason’s Mirror Shield, and the bullseye on the island for Atalanta’s Power Arrow.

6df52424.say: Medusa’s Hall. When her eye glows, she Glares across the hall. Hide behind a pillar, or face her behind the Mirror Shield and bounce it back!

6793336e.say: This is it: the labyrinth under the gate of Colchis. The Argo can’t fit down here, so it’s up to you two.

d15f7679.say: The walls are carved with Gardener light-words. This was a garden path once... a long, long time ago.

4f9c503e.say: And now it’s full of statues of robots. Gold robots. With very surprised faces.

ad9506c2.say: Why are they made of stone? Robots aren’t made of stone. Jason, why are they made of Stone?

fd5c6805.say: Let’s find out. Carefully. Stay close, Lux.

55f2fd1e.say: Memo to my new security system, Medusa. Watch the gate to Colchis. Let Nobody through but me.

bdf8f60d.say: Yes, your gaze turned my own workers to stone. Yes, I am still waiting for them to un-stone. That is fine. Workers are cheap.

5855bb20.say: Oh, and some old Gardener junk is lying about in a shrine down there. A shield? Shiny, but worthless. Leave it.

be9d5d8c.say: Intruders Detected. Two Small Humans. Two Small Droids. Please Look Into My Eyes.

e93862ee.say: Her gaze turns things to stone only for a moment, but the robots here stayed still too long. Keep moving, and use the statues as cover.

ba8bffc9.say: The Gardeners planted mirrors here to carry sunlight down into the maze. Now they carry Medusa’s gaze instead.

612e644b.say: Then we turn them around and make her gaze work for us!

037ddf86.say: Nobody? Watch me. Jason, you light the crystal. I’ll take the bullseye.

6e43b023.say: You Switched Off My Eyes. You Bent My Gaze With Mirrors. That Is Very Rude.

74b4625d.say: She sounds upset. Maybe we should knock first?

960141f7.say: I Am Medusa, Guardian Of The Gate. Master Ee-ee-tees Says: Nobody Passes.

893ffec3.say: Quite right, darling! Turn them into two lovely little statues. I’ll put them in my lobby.

e7e8ea88.say: Atalanta, keep her snakes busy. When she glares, I’ll show her what a mirror is for!

dc9443d5.say: My... Own... Gaze. So... Bright. Security System... Going To Sleep Mode.

8cd59a93.say: Goodnight, little heroes. The gate... is yours.

a0a9ada5.say: Listen! The stone robots are waking up. Her gaze only held them while she was watching.

8c7e3114.say: And they’re running away from Ee-ee-tees as fast as they can. Smart robots.

91c6e920.say: The old gate is open! It goes all the way up to Colchis’s sky-dock.

2704ef6a.say: A Gardener light-stone, hidden where only a slider could find it. It glows green, then gold: path.

45b08236.say: A path! I hope it’s a path Out of here.

730e0cb5.say: Up on the ledge! It glows white, then deep blue... like the moon in the sky.

62aa1be3.say: That is the word for light. The Gardeners used it to mean hope, too.

9655a514.say: The bonus crystal opened a secret room! And look: a light-stone that flickers like a mirror.

9198534e.say: It means see. Or maybe look closer. Gardener words are very clever.

01039096.say: The Captain’s picnic basket! The cable snakes stole it right off the Argo’s ramp.

236a25dd.say: My picnic! Thank you, Lux. There are grapes in there for everybody. Even for the droids. Well... grape-shaped bolts.

26d26b10.say: My emergency snacks! Those snakes have very good taste. And very bad manners.

b525a002.say: You keep losing your snacks, Atalanta.

cb0ce37e.say: And I keep getting them Back. That’s what matters.

8f324fb1.say: In the Gardeners’ shrine, on an altar of green stone, lay a round shield as bright as a pool of water.

ced7efa3.say: The Gardeners’ Mirror Shield. They used it to carry sunlight into dark places, so the gardens could grow underground.

ecd4ee69.say: It’s so light! And look: I can see us in it. We look... brave.

b2871c6f.say: You look like you need a haircut. Now, let’s see Medusa try her stony stare on That.

a6f40e6d.say: Just like Perseus in the old story! Except we are not going to hurt anybody. We are just going to... bounce things.

10e5043d.say: Medusa slept, and her cable snakes curled up like kittens. Behind her, the old gate of Colchis stood open.

605e410b.say: She is only asleep. She was built to guard, and she did her best. Maybe one day she will guard something better.

1eca7446.say: Sleep well, Medusa. We’ll leave the light on.

21973b6e.say: Argonauts! I see you on the scanner. That shaft goes straight up to the Gardeners’ sky-dock. The Argo will meet you there.

87a5f0e0.say: Ramlings! Ee-ee-tees’s little gold rams paw the ground, then charge head first. Hold up your Shield and they bonk their silly heads. Then hit them while they’re dizzy!

60cc68db.say: Ee-ee-tees cracked the stone to block the bridge. Hold the Cannon for a Big Blast, or Charge into it.

48865b80.say: Too far to jump! Charge (the Dash button), then Jump while you charge: a Charge-Leap.

439ba62f.say: The bar at the top is the Argo coming in. Wake the dock guns at the Command Post, then hold the dock by the beacon. The Argo only flies at full speed while the dock is clear of Ee-ee-tees’s robots!

ab3210bc.say: A crate barricade! Charge straight through it.

aea5e5af.say: Gold troopers shoot down this walkway. Hold the Shield and march: every shot bounces off.

e85a6815.say: The gate to the east only opens while something heavy stands on its plate. One of your old robots is standing about doing nothing. Give it an order!

bbb933a6.say: Ee-ee-tees’s lockbox. Your old Legion wrist computer can crack it.

c13eadca.say: The last line before the Sky Gate. Wake the guns, hold the beacon, and the Argo will be nearly here.

d7dc1b60.say: Ee-ee-tees drops your old Legion robots here, painted gold. Use this Command Post and they’ll fight for you instead!

ea2c1da0.say: The Golden Ram charges like a bull. Shield its horns, Charge it into a stone pillar, then Blast its open engine!

1ced170b.say: High above Colchis, an old stone dock floats in the clouds. Its great arch is the only way down to the Gardeners’ garden.

adbe275a.say: Colchis’s sky-dock. The Gardeners built it to welcome their friends. Today it welcomes the Argo.

a6629a28.say: General, Ee-ee-tees’s whole gold fleet is on its way to shut that arch. The Argo needs a few minutes to get through.

5722306e.say: Then she shall have them. Legion! Guns on the bridges. Nobody touches that arch.

9330b8ff.say: Hmph. Yes, little sprout. One last stand. And then I would very much like a cup of tea.

426df928.say: Low over the dock, white and gold, the Argo slipped through the great arch.

a6eb3da6.say: Argo to the sky-dock! We are through the gate! Brennus... thank you.

4f09796d.say: Look! He’s saluting! General, you were Amazing!

297aafc7.say: A few dents. Nothing a cup of tea won’t fix. Now go and find that Fleece, Argonauts.

baf71fe1.say: A Gardener light-stone, on an islet in the clouds. The sprout is glowing back at it. Sky blue, then white... sky, I suppose.

683e1056.say: Another one, out on the ledge. Green, then gold, warm as a hand on your shoulder. I think it means friend.

9a1e5d08.say: Ee-ee-tees walled this one in. It shines gold and purple, slow and steady. Even an old soldier can read this one: stand.

a3ae0121.say: Yes, yes. I told everyone I was flying home. I lied. A little.

5847347e.say: General Brennus! Again! Don’t you ever retire?

406f4445.say: I tried. Gardening, tea, a nice comfortable brig. Then you came along.

da60b659.say: My fleet will shut that arch long before your little Argo gets here. Ships! Drop the troops!

e90a9eba.say: Legion, with me. We hold the dock until the Argo is through.

9ee8dc93.say: Brennus, it’s Argus. I’m beaming this to the dock’s old beacon in case your radio is off again.

04b6a71f.say: The Argo is coming in low, under Ee-ee-tees’s fleet. Every line you hold brings her closer. Keep the beacons green.

6cb97585.say: And Brennus... come back in one piece. That’s an order. Well. A request.

c1d37111.say: You can’t hold a whole dock with a few rusty robots, old man!

38d637bb.say: Watch me. Command post first: those dock guns have been asleep long enough.

240ac99e.say: The Argo is getting closer, General! Two more lines to hold.

dcf9457a.say: One at a time, Halcyon. One at a time.

cbac67bf.say: Fine! Have some of Your old robots back. I painted them gold. They work for Me now!

2f48da43.say: Robots painted gold are still my robots, Ee-ee-tees. They remember my voice.

461fabbc.say: General, something huge just landed by the arch. It has... horns?

643af2bb.say: Of course it does. Shop first, then horns.

dcc5bd90.say: Meet my Golden Ram! Solid gold, and it butts like a battleship. Butt him off my dock, Ram!

fee4524c.say: Come on then, woolly. Let us see whose head is harder.

5b3d4565.say: My Ram! It’s... lying down?! Get Up, you overpriced lawn ornament!

18ec3cf8.say: It is having a little nap. Engines need a rest, Ee-ee-tees. So do old generals.

6f17524f.say: General! The Argo is right behind you. Coming through the arch... Now!

94df4eb6.say: A Light-Word Gate! The Gardeners locked their gates with words of light. Step on a word’s colours, in order. This gate opens for Home: blue, then green.
