80a3b3d2.say: Lily pads! Hop across the glowing pond. As Atalanta, wall-run along the striped hedge to the little island. As Jason, Grapple up the old stump to the gold net.

b5903faa.say: The Crystal Gate needs Both of you: a bullseye on the spire in the ravine for Atalanta’s Power Arrow, and a red switch on the crystal pillar for Jason (Grapple up, then Ground-Pound).

7b56fde7.say: The great fountain glows: Only a Friend may pass. Our word for friend shines with the whole rainbow: red, orange, yellow, green, blue and violet.

3eef5779.say: An old Gardener riddle: First the seed must Sleep, then it will Grow. Sleep glows violet, then white. Grow glows pink, then green.

bcebaf86.say: Lullaby Pylons! Light all four for the lullaby: follow the beams. Sky: Atalanta’s Power Arrow. Grow: Jason’s Ground Pound. Home: high on the hedge shelf (Atalanta Wall-Jumps). Friend: on the crystal column (Jason Grapples). Their light melts gold chains too: be ready for a fight!

14d25957.say: The Argo is down, safe and sound, right in the Gardeners’ garden. Brennus held that sky-dock just long enough.

048c16ab.say: Oh... look at it. Flowers taller than the Argo. Trees made of crystal. Fountains that speak in light.

631c55ff.say: And somebody’s spraying gold goop all over it. Those little gold drones with the scissors!

b081025b.say: Weeder drones. Ee-ee-tees’s, of course. They’re snipping the flowers! That is just Rude.

ad71f691.say: The Fleece vault is inside the great tree-temple, at the heart of the garden. But something huge is curled around its door. And it is... breathing.

8779e7a8.say: Then we go carefully. Atalanta, you take the high roads. Lux, Iris: you read the light-words. Let’s go!

b1335f97.say: Doctor Hypatia here, recording on the Argo. I’ve been studying the light-stones you found. Every Gardener word is a little song of colours.

68c8fc00.say: The Gardeners locked their gates with those words. Step on the colours of the right word, in order, and the gate will open.

beb52a21.say: One more thing. The old carvings speak of a guardian that never sleeps. They say: When it rages, be brave. When it tires, sing to it. I wonder what that means...

8183f486.say: Another locked gate! That bullseye is on a spire out in the ravine. Nobody can get there... but my arrows can.

67c7a7af.say: And the red switch is up on that crystal pillar. Too smooth to climb. Good thing I brought a grapple.

7dacb3b1.say: The Gardeners built this garden for friends who help each other. I think they would like you two.

7a8d6fb7.say: Ah, the little Argonauts! My weeder drones have been poking that old dragon all week, and I chained it to its tree. It is Very awake now, and Very cross. Enjoy!

f3f0d222.say: It is not a monster. It is a guardian, and it is so tired. It has not slept for a thousand years, guarding the Fleece.

c8ac7046.say: Then we light the lullaby pylons, and you two sing it to sleep. Whatever it takes!

e8e7ec8b.say: Sing? To That? ...Okay. Okay! I know one song. It is mostly beeps.

5bd31926.say: Shhh... Listen. It is snoring. Very, very softly.

58185fa8.say: We did it! We sang a dragon to sleep! I am the bravest singer in the galaxy.

e237daf5.say: Sweet dreams, big guy. We’ll bring the Fleece back... well, to Celestia. She needs it more.

99e176de.say: The tree-temple’s door is opening. The way to the Golden Fleece is clear.

aef03649.say: A light-stone, out on the little island! It glows violet... then soft white, like moonlight.

52aa84ca.say: This word means sleep. A good word to know, in a garden with a guardian that never sleeps.

e6d7b3f1.say: Hidden where only a slider fits. Gold and pink, rippling like water: this word is song.

ed3aea29.say: Sleep... song... It’s like the Gardeners left us a lullaby, one word at a time!

c10ce909.say: Up on the crystal plinth! This one starts dark green and bursts bright white, like a sunrise.

402982d7.say: Wake. The word the Gardeners said to their seeds every spring. One day we will say it to Celestia’s.

932de3cb.say: A seed-sprite! The Gardeners’ little helpers. It says Pip! Pip-pip! That means thank you, kind giants!

628710c1.say: Giants! Did you hear that, Jason? I’m a Giant.

9f4d7cc6.say: This one was napping on the old stump when the weeders netted it. It says it will plant a flower for you.

0126e133.say: In your ear, if you stand still for too long. Seed-sprites are very helpful.

f93e5277.say: The last one! It is flying off to tell the whole garden that the weeders are gone. Look: they are all waving at us.

4ae07958.say: Bye, little sprites! Keep your flowers safe!

1ec23b36.say: Colchis, at last. The Argonauts step out into the garden the Gardeners planted long, long ago.

aead4184.say: Sleep, old guardian. Your watch is over. Friends are here.

d2ab3a22.say: Beep... boop... sleeeep... (that’s the beep version).

a3209342.say: Look. It’s curling up around the tree. Its eyes are closing...

7cdd9266.say: The Gardeners’ Tree-Temple. Tap the switch button to swap between Jason and Atalanta. Each hero has moves the other one doesn’t!

8d2d6943.say: Ring Guards! They hide behind their gold ring, then throw it like a boomerang. Jump over the ring, and hit the guard while its ring is away.

6f4b0528.say: The root gate opens with a bullseye up on that ledge. Switch to Atalanta, hold Bow for a Power Arrow, and let go!

2305d880.say: A crawl tunnel in the roots, with yellow-and-black stripes: only Atalanta’s Slide fits under. Something glows at the far end...

fe252bd7.say: Cracked rock with gold in the cracks! Only General Brennus can smash it: switch to him, then Charge into it, or Hold the Cannon for a Big Blast.

6593b35c.say: A Legion Command Post! As General Brennus, walk up and press Command. His old robots still know his voice.

cce09fe4.say: The Fleece Vault. Three seals, three heroes: follow the three beams of light! Atalanta: a Power Arrow at the bullseye up high. Jason: Grapple up the root pillar, then Pound the red switch. General Brennus: Smash the cracked rock, then Pound the switch behind it.

b2aa2f12.say: The Gardeners’ oldest poem, in light-words: Under the Sky, the little seeds Grow. A Friend carries them Home. Step on the colours of the poem in order, and the Gardeners’ chest will open.

3305d8db.say: Argonauts, this is it: the Gardeners’ great tree-temple. The Fleece is somewhere at the very top.

65bdfd67.say: The Sleepless Dragon is snoring away behind us. It sounds like a very happy volcano.

dd7e8c2d.say: And That sounds like gold drones. Lots of them. Ee-ee-tees got here first!

016d9fab.say: First doesn’t mean fastest. Race you to the top, Jason!

c0c960c6.say: Not yet! Together, remember? Come on, Lux. Let’s bring Celestia her Fleece.

f63e1f92.say: Argonauts, it’s Doctor Hypatia, beaming this through the Argo. Celestia is very weak today. Her glow is almost gone.

f2332c8f.say: But this morning she flashed three words at General Brennus’s little sprout: brave, friends, hurry.

b18d83d3.say: And then Brennus took the Gorgon’s lifeboat and flew off toward Colchis. Without telling Anyone. Again. Please look after each other.

4a6e13e1.say: Get back, you overgrown tin waiters! I have a cannon, and I have a very bad temper!

fbfe6a92.say: That voice... it’s General Brennus! His lifeboat crashed right through the tree!

57f65c8c.say: Ee-ee-tees’s guards have him trapped. Let’s give him a hand!

c880fdde.say: Hmph. I had them exactly where I wanted them.

459bb72c.say: ...Mostly where I wanted them. Thank you, Argonauts.

54f0de43.say: General Brennus has joined the Argonauts! Tap the switch button to swap between all Three heroes: Jason, Atalanta and the General.

38ec9942.say: Brennus has a cannon, a shield and a Charge that smashes cracked rock! And he brought his own robots!

27e42a08.say: The Fleece vault. The Gardeners closed it with three seals, and wrote on the gate in light-words.

651bc750.say: It says: Only those who stand Together may enter. Three seals. Three heroes. That’s us!

63ead9f6.say: Together. I keep finding that word everywhere these days.

1eedc00f.say: See the three beams of light? One for each hero, in their colour. Bring the right hero close to a beam and press the action button!

edbd25d4.say: Ah, the Argonauts! Right on time to watch me collect my prize. Look at it. The Golden Fleece.

5dbda46e.say: With this I can make a thousand green planets... and sell every single one of them!

a96173b9.say: Watch me, little scout. My drones, my rings! Take out the trash!

326c1909.say: Everybody together, just like the gate said. Let’s go!

d4602f3e.say: Enough! If you won’t let me sell the Fleece... I will Wear it!

357d4038.say: No! The Fleece is alive. It will not like being worn by someone so greedy!

5f450d7f.say: Ha ha Ha! Gold armour! Gold vines! I am the Golden King now, and everything I touch is Mine!

55aa6b6d.say: I know that look. I wore it once myself. Argonauts: my shield will stop his charge. Then hit him with everything!

f7a9bb2e.say: Still standing? Then Grow, Fleece! Make me bigger! Make me the biggest thing on this moon!

96e29188.say: Uh-oh. Uh-oh. He’s growing. Why do the bad guys Always grow?

bc3f3cd8.say: Look: the Fleece’s vines are holding him to the floor. Atalanta, your arrows can cut them!

5f22fc03.say: Then I will crack that crystal on his chest, and the last shot is yours, boy.

9baa5ad2.say: One hero each. Let’s finish this!

8a47ffab.say: No, no, No! Come back, Fleece! I bought you! ...Well, I was Going to buy you!

9d5b282b.say: The Fleece chose, Ee-ee-tees. It does not want to be owned. Nothing alive does.

5d0d5270.say: And look: it tied him up with its own vines, like a big gold present!

79a6d090.say: Mmph! Let me out! I have a Very important meeting about selling a moon!

2fe5a700.say: The Golden Fleece. It’s so warm... like holding a sunbeam.

052a95a1.say: Celestia is waiting. Let’s take it home, Jason!

9ef1c81c.say: In Gardener! Sky... grow... friend... home... together!

88495fda.say: The Fleece is answering! Every seed in it is waking up. They say... We are Celestia’s family.

d017b6fb.say: Celestia isn’t the last of her kind. She’s got a Whole Fleece of brothers and sisters!

284d11dd.say: Then let’s take them home. All of them. Together!

934c5a85.say: A light-stone, hidden at the end of the crawl tunnel. It glows warm orange, then soft green: seed.

c24adaa4.say: Seed! Like the ones in the Fleece. The Gardeners really liked gardening, huh?

1402ea6a.say: A light-stone on the hidden ledge! This one shines silver, then blue: it means wake up.

9ddc8385.say: Funny word to leave in a tree full of sleeping things.

0b397983.say: The last light-stone of the temple. It glows every colour, slowly, like a heartbeat: family.

706a7707.say: Family. Hmph. The sprout on my belt is glowing like a lantern. I think it likes that one.

3add7120.say: A Gardener seed jar, stolen by Ee-ee-tees’s crew! The seeds inside are older than the moon, and still warm.

c1e9011e.say: We’ll put it back where it belongs. Gently. Very, very gently.

99aad5e2.say: A Gardener sky-harp! Listen: it plays a little tune all by itself.

66b73127.say: My grandmother used to hum that tune in her greenhouse. ...How strange.

b3aac03f.say: A Gardener star-lantern, stuffed into a gold net. It glows every colour at once!

2d135c77.say: The Gardeners lit their way with these. Now it can light ours.

bd02063f.say: I came to help. Celestia is fading, and an old soldier still knows how to march.

e4fe0164.say: And I brought my squad. My own robots, the ones I painted green again. They plant trees now. They also bite.

24db9165.say: You flew off alone without telling anyone? Who does that?

542e24b0.say: Hmph. I hear it runs in the crew.

6cc0d8e0.say: Welcome to the Argonauts, General. Let’s get that Fleece. Together.

c4da7c60.say: Jet Boots! Now you can jump again while you are in the air. Double jump!

cf02a6e3.say: Dash Thrusters! Press Dash to zoom forward, even in mid-air. Great for long gaps!

35ed6722.say: A dash hits Hard too: ram straight through enemies! Each one uses an energy cell. Checkpoints and violet energy cells fill you back up.

abf7f862.say: A Hover Pack! Hold Jump while you fall to float gently down. Wheee!

24cb792a.say: I can glide across the whole Ring with this!

eab35b1c.say: King Bloblin is on the island in the Middle of the Ring. Climb the launch tower, follow the gold marker and glide over!

1ff4a4c1.say: Force Pulse installed! Press Pulse and I blast out a shockwave. It knocks out every enemy around you!

584364d4.say: It also shorts out lasers for a few seconds. But it takes me a Long time to recharge, so pick your moment.

7d8b3000.say: Those laser walls don’t stand a chance.

1af9c8a1.say: A Grapple Hook! See the glowing rings? Look at one and press Grapple to zip right over to it!

4fe6fce9.say: It works over gaps, up cliffs, even across quicksand. If the ring glows bright, you can reach it.

d06373c7.say: Hold on to your antenna, Lux!

989f54fa.say: The Gardeners’ Mirror Shield! It’s polished so bright, I can see all my scratches.

5a01fe12.say: Hold the Spin button to raise it. Medusa’s green gaze bounces right off it instead of turning you to stone!

16bc59b1.say: A shield that bounces light. Just like Perseus in the old story!

2807177b.say: A golden cloak that makes dead worlds bloom? Ha! Imagine the Price of a brand new green planet.

9b715f36.say: I am Ee-ee-tees, and I buy and sell Everything. Find me that Fleece, my little drones. Before anyone else does.

ff53c75c.say: In the old stories, a ship called the Argo carried the bravest heroes in the world on a quest for a Golden Fleece.

cb9b111b.say: Our Argo has a ram’s head on the prow, solar oars and a great solar sail. And our heroes are... a little shorter.

b3ae6ece.say: All systems ready. Crew: Jason, Lux, Doctor Hypatia, Captain Argus, and me. Please keep your hands inside the ship.

94b6171d.say: Attention, colony ship. This is General Brennus, of the warship Gorgon.

65f4c6ac.say: I reached Gaia Nova forty years before you. This world is Mine. Every tree, every river, every rock.

b2eba79c.say: Your scientists came poking around my planet. They will be my guests for a while.

d397aec7.say: And you have brought back something of mine. That little plant you call Gas-koo. Its real name is Celestia.

6f11248f.say: Brennus... my first commander. He led the first expedition here, forty years ago. We all thought he was lost.

9355e8b6.say: Hello, Argus. Turn your ship around and fly away, or meet my Thorn Legion.

6fcd1f01.say: With one mighty pull on the wheel, the Syracusia swung away from the star.

0423b447.say: The vines let go of the ship. The Heart of Gas-koo curled up into a tiny, sleeping seed.

f09460b1.say: Weeks later, the pods opened one by one above a green-and-blue world: Gaia Nova.

8bee6b9f.say: Ten thousand colonists had a new home. And a brand new hero.

faf3fd28.say: Lux flashed the words: hello... safe... together. And for the first time, Gas-koo flashed back.

0df77075.say: Its vines turned gold and burst into flowers. After a long, long time in the dark, Gas-koo was not afraid anymore.

704a1db3.say: Gently, it turned the Syracusia away from the star and back toward the warm blue world it had run from. It was not scared anymore: now it had friends.

e0b72a95.say: Ten thousand colonists woke up in a garden between the stars. And Lux was never scared of the dark again, because now something always glows.

02e10990.say: The Colossus crashed down into the crater, and Mount Atlantas let out one last, tired puff of smoke.

25401bce.say: Celestia’s vines slipped free of the machines. All over Gaia Nova, the Thorn Legion switched off and went quiet.

315b82f8.say: General Brennus was taken up to the Syracusia to explain himself to Captain Argus. It was going to be a Very long talk.

ed285e95.say: And at last, the colonists stepped out onto Gaia Nova: a brand new home that belonged to everyone.

4a103c48.say: Brennus read the very first page of his journal, the one he wrote when he was twelve... and lowered his hands.

02ee8969.say: I came here to make this world obey me, he said. I forgot that the best gardens are the ones you share.

5be4d729.say: Together, Brennus, the scientists and Celestia turned the Thorn Legion into the Green Legion: robots that plant forests instead of fighting.

075b9101.say: On the colony’s first morning, Celestia bloomed across the whole valley. Gaia Nova was home at last, for everyone.

dde7f98a.say: The Golden King’s armour fell away like autumn leaves, and the Fleece floated down, soft and warm, into Jason’s arms.

8232d819.say: The Argo carried it home across the ring of moons, past the Clashing Rocks, all the way back to Gaia Nova.

b6a5ff88.say: In the colony’s garden, the Argonauts laid the Golden Fleece over Celestia, like a blanket made of sunshine.

8069793d.say: Celestia opened her petals and glowed brighter than ever before. She was strong again, and the whole valley bloomed.

9092ee6e.say: Lux and Iris spoke the Gardeners’ words in light: sky, grow, friend, home... and the Fleece answered.

d3f8239a.say: Every golden seed in the Fleece woke up and began to glow. They had waited a very long time for someone to say hello.

84e81e9f.say: At home on Gaia Nova, the Fleece settled over Celestia, and its seeds drifted down all around her like golden snow.

d655ff99.say: By spring, a hundred little Celestias were blooming across the valley. She was not the last of her kind anymore. She had a family.

700a916e.say: Celestia? Celestia, please wake up! Doctor Hypatia, what do we do?

e6cdc43a.say: These old ruins are covered in Celestia’s light-words. Lux, can you read them with me?

8368f089.say: They say... Gardeners. Celestia’s people called themselves the Gardeners!

a5174fa0.say: The Gardeners left a gift on Colchis, a moon of the gas giant next door: a living golden cloak of seeds. The Golden Fleece. It can make any world bloom.

78d9e636.say: Then it can make Celestia strong again! How do we get there?

ef950f9c.say: Hydroponics: the gardens that feed the whole ship. Gas-koo loves it here... a little too much.

edf27bc8.say: The Engine Core. The coolant pumps are off, the lava is rising, and something big is stomping around.

afa1dbf0.say: The Habitat Ring, where the colonists live. Home, sweet, gooey home.

3e065877.say: The Security Deck. Lasers, cameras... and a voice that does not sound like Halcyon anymore.

f45eef5c.say: The Bridge. The star fills every window now. At the very top, the Heart of Gas-koo is waiting.

dca653bb.say: The Whispering Plains of Gaia Nova. Golden grass as far as you can see... and the science team’s camp, empty.

ce98e97c.say: The Glass Desert. Sand that sparkles like sugar, ruins older than anyone remembers, and Brennus’s drills chewing through it all.

2e48abc4.say: The Frostpeak Tundra. Somewhere in this blizzard is Brennus’s prison camp, and the scientists he captured.

9156a75a.say: The Titan Rockies. Cliffs taller than the Syracusia, rickety bridges, and up at the very top... the wreck of the Gorgon.

ce9e1902.say: The Thornwood Jungle. Something is wrong here: the trees are grey, and Celestia’s pollen hangs in the air like fog.

eb1ff288.say: Mount Atlantas. Brennus built his fortress right inside the volcano. Celestia is in there. So is the end of this.

18e5fffd.say: The Clashing Rocks. A glittering belt of asteroids guards the ring of moons... and somewhere in it, two giant rocks keep slamming together.

bd004d61.say: The strait of Scylla’s Reef. Coral, sunshine and turquoise water... between a great dark rock and a whirlpool that never stops turning.

cc74fa8d.say: The Harpy Isles. Little green islands float on the wind, high above a sea of clouds... and something gold keeps flapping between them.

aaaecd88.say: The mining moon of Ee-ee-tees. He is digging the whole moon into a golden pit... and General Brennus has just landed in it, all on his own.

c6629639.say: The Sirens’ Sea. Deep under the waves of a water moon lies a sunken Gardener gate... and Ee-ee-tees’s gold buoys are singing a very strange song.

8c8cb133.say: The bronze island of Talos. Lava channels, an ancient Gardener forge... and a bronze giant as tall as a tower, walking his rounds.

02715024.say: Medusa’s Labyrinth. Under the gate of Colchis winds a maze of green stone... and in the dark, a great green eye is opening.

43fb150e.say: The sky-dock of Colchis, floating above the clouds. Ee-ee-tees’s gold fleet is coming to shut its gate... and one old general is standing in the way.

479181f5.say: The Garden of Colchis. Flowers as tall as houses, trees of glowing crystal, and fountains that whisper in light... and somewhere in the middle, something very big is not asleep.

0ea485d7.say: The great tree-temple of the Gardeners, taller than any mountain. Somewhere at the top, the Golden Fleece is waiting... and so is Ee-ee-tees.

2757534a.say: The colony ship Syracusia. Ten thousand people asleep in their pods, on the long journey to a new home.

3de2ad1a.say: The ship computer, Halcyon, kept watch. For months, everything was quiet...

e014fea7.say: ...until something came flying out of the dark.

ea2678c6.say: It was not a comet. It was a seed: a glowing space vine called the Galactic Cuscuta Echinochloa. Gas-koo, for short.

948394b4.say: Gas-koo grew and grew. It wrapped the crew in soft cocoons and made the robots go haywire.

39b62f7a.say: Then its roots reached the Bridge... and it turned the ship toward a burning star.

df74942c.say: But deep inside, on the Cryo Deck, one little pod was waking up early.

0f438107.say: After months between the stars, the Syracusia reached its new home: a green and blue world called Gaia Nova.

cda98923.say: Captain Argus sent the science team down first. Their leader, Doctor Hypatia, would find the perfect place to land.

cc71587e.say: Three days later, their radio went quiet...

3ddd6e3a.say: ...and then a message came up from the planet.

29e97b8a.say: That night, little black drones swooped onto the Syracusia, grabbed Celestia and flew it down to the planet.

11da4fe7.say: So Jason and Lux climbed into the shuttle and flew down to Gaia Nova.

3c025841.say: Spring came to Gaia Nova. The colonists planted their very first garden, and Celestia bloomed right in the middle of it.

8b9924f6.say: But one morning, Celestia’s glow began to fade. She was the last of her kind... and she was getting very tired.

1f380aa2.say: So Captain Argus rebuilt the old shuttle into a brand new ship, and named her the Argo.

b3e8f7fa.say: Her crew called themselves the Argonauts.

de534459.say: One bright morning, the Argo lifted off from the Whispering Plains...

3e5c394f.say: ...toward the gas giant next door and its ring of moons. One of them was Colchis.

5a9a8bbd.say: But someone else was heading there too.

9a9398a7.say: Jason, I know its light-words now! Get close to the Heart and press Speak!

2f953399.say: Jason, you read every page of his journal. You know who he really is. Get close and Talk to him!

59db06ef.say: Lux, we know every Gardener word now. When this is over, we can speak to the Fleece itself!

8d650812.say: Gas-koo! I mean... Celestia! They took it! Jason, they Took it!

b867b625.say: Celestia: the name the first expedition gave it. He wants its pollen for his army. Jason, Lux: take the shuttle down. Find the scientists, and bring Celestia back.

b426a57f.say: We will, Captain. Come on, Lux. Gaia Nova needs us.

b218b6c8.say: Lift engaged! Jason, take a look out of the window.

39103adb.say: Whoa. Is that the star? It is So bright.

a01d2da4.say: At this speed we will be too close in three days. Plenty of time! Probably. Maybe.

bf5f5c27.say: Look at the vines on the hull. They all grow toward the Bridge... like roots going home.

ecaba487.say: Warning: the ship is speeding up. The engines are running way too hot.

b2aff41a.say: Not me! Something on the Bridge. Gas-koo is in a hurry to reach that star.

5983cf96.say: The Engine Core is full of lava. I will stay Very close to you. Like, super close.

bc506875.say: The Habitat Ring is next... that is where I live. Where Aunt Rosa lives.

f1aeb86e.say: Is she nice? Does she like drones?

7b98ef0a.say: She is the Security Chief. She is the bravest person I know. She will be okay. She has to be.

ade326a6.say: Lift to the Habitat Ring. The star is getting... bzzt... closer.

4024d0b6.say: The pollen! It got into Halcyon’s computer core. That is on the Security Deck!

774f3370.say: Then that is where we are going. Hang on, Halcyon.

f32fa799.say: Final lift: the Bridge. Jason, the star is Very close now. I can feel my circuits sweating.

28a725f3.say: Lux... if Gas-koo talks in lights, could you talk to it?

3763a04f.say: Maybe! If I knew its words. The memory shards are full of its memories...

7e896aff.say: With every memory shard, Lux might learn its language. If not, you will have to stop the Heart the hard way.

d27cfb50.say: Shuttle systems online. Next stop: the Glass Desert. Doctor Hypatia’s team was digging there before the radio went quiet.

4c02cb36.say: The scientists we freed said Brennus took the others south. Why would he want a bunch of scientists?

bcd4f085.say: Maybe he needs someone clever. He does not seem clever. He seems... grumpy.

1c8b6de3.say: Grumpy And dangerous. His drills are all over the desert. Please land somewhere soft.

c36a663c.say: Jason, those ruins! The lights on the walls were Celestia’s light-words. Hello, safe, together!

5195bdae.say: So Celestia’s people were here once? A long, long time ago?

4211154e.say: That would explain why Celestia dreamed of a warm blue world. It was not a dream. It was a memory.

b8287d6b.say: And now Brennus wants to turn it into a weapon. Not if we can help it. North, to the tundra!

8379daf5.say: Doctor Galen is safe on board the Syracusia. He slept for forty years and woke up very hungry. He has eaten eleven pancakes.

2fc12696.say: That’s good. ...Halcyon, any sign of Lux?

b1050eba.say: Not yet. But Engineer Ariadne heard something: Brennus is building something called the Colossus. And he writes everything in his journal. Find the pages, and you will understand him.

259c7409.say: Then I’ll find every page. And I’ll find Lux.

019a1de4.say: The Gorgon crashed up there forty years ago. Brennus has been alone on this planet ever since.

e63c1bc9.say: Forty years alone. One day without Lux and I’m already talking to myself.

b0d1279b.say: You are talking to me, Jason. That counts. Warning: the jungle ahead is thick with Celestia pollen. Something has gone very wrong down there.

34ca8372.say: Then we fix it. Hang on, Celestia. Hang on, Lux. I’m coming.

3056782f.say: That was Celestia, speaking in pink light through the pollen. It is inside the volcano... and so is your friend.

b3e3d0b5.say: Mount Atlantas. Brennus’s fortress. The Colossus will be waiting for you.

6b6ff0de.say: So will we. One last climb, Iris. We’re bringing Lux home.

dc9422e0.say: One last climb. I will light the way.

99272fb7.say: Course set for the first moon. Its floating islands are called the Harpy Isles.

98e81065.say: Harpies? Like the grabby bird monsters in the old story?

e9b4ef40.say: Captain, I am picking up a little distress beacon down there. It belongs to one of Our scout skiffs!

d84b6ee5.say: A colony skiff, all the way out here? ...Oh dear. I know exactly who flies off alone like that.

598966f7.say: We got through the Clashing Rocks. We can get through anything!

67d015f8.say: Captain, a message is coming in from Gaia Nova. It is... General Brennus?

da0b582d.say: Argus. I saw Ee-ee-tees’s gold ships fly over the colony. I know that kind of greed. I used to have it.

6ed7b6cf.say: He is digging for the Fleece in a mine on the next moon. I am taking the Gorgon’s old lifeboat, and I am going after him. Alone.

bd4fa193.say: Brennus, wait! ...He switched his radio off. Stubborn as ever.

76bdc0ec.say: Flying off alone without telling anyone? Who would do something so silly? ...Don’t look at me like that.

2a818bb7.say: Then we keep going, and we listen for his signal. Hang on, General!

9dbacac5.say: Argo to everyone: a message is coming in. From... the Gorgon’s old lifeboat?

c0bf31ce.say: Argus. It is Brennus. I am sending you a map: the way into the Fleece vault on Colchis. Ee-ee-tees was hiding it in his desk.

d99a9eaa.say: You went into Ee-ee-tees’s mine Alone? Brennus, are you hurt?

a27bed25.say: A few dents. My robots and I are flying home. You fly to Colchis. The map says the way goes through the Sirens’ Sea.

aa6e25f3.say: Thank you, General. ...Brennus. That was really brave.

289e5792.say: Hmph. Tell Celestia her little sprout says hello.

3ba63ec6.say: Dolphin, you are back on the surface! Hold still, the Argo is coming to scoop you up.

50d85957.say: Jason! You beat a giant singing Organ, and I missed it? Next time I am coming in the sub.

996b9e4d.say: Look ahead: a strait between a tall rock and a great whirlpool. The coral there grows like a city.

91f69639.say: Brennus’s map says that reef is the way to Colchis. But someone has built something very big on that rock...

bf3f2cc4.say: Is it another organ? Please say it is not another organ. My singing voice needs a rest.

ed1b7f5b.say: Then this time we go on foot. Atalanta, ready to run?

5d1d37fa.say: Argo to the reef: the strait is clear! Scylla’s arms are folded, and Charybdis is just a gentle swirl. We are sailing through.

03f90dbe.say: Beyond the strait there is an island of black rock and bronze cliffs. Its volcano is smoking... and something enormous is walking along the beach.

f1cb1888.say: About as tall as a ten-storey building. And it is made of bronze.

18cbd654.say: Oh good. A giant. I was worried today would be boring.

5a501169.say: The map says the way to Colchis goes right across that island. Let’s go and say hello. Politely.

f835aa2e.say: The labyrinth gate. The Gardeners built a maze under Colchis to keep the Fleece safe.

57a2a00f.say: I am detecting a security system down there. One of Ee-ee-tees’s. It calls itself... Medusa.

7e7306ef.say: Medusa? Like the old story? The one who turns people into Stone?

c75a5241.say: Then we don’t look her in the eye. Easy. ...Is it easy?

8231dddf.say: Talos is resting, the gate is open, and Colchis is right under our feet. Come on, Argonauts!

75d62a14.say: Argonauts, the labyrinth gate is open! The Argo can fly straight up the old shaft to the Gardeners’ sky-dock.

7f511eac.say: But... I count twenty gold ships coming round the moon. Ee-ee-tees has brought his whole fleet.

77d14c1d.say: You switched off my Medusa? Then I will close the sky myself. Nobody reaches the garden but Me!

dbd3ed49.say: Argus. Brennus here. My lifeboat is right behind you, and my old robots are with me.

b5d6bb21.say: I will hold the sky-dock. You fly through to the garden. Do not argue, Captain. Just fly.

258668dd.say: Holding a whole dock against a whole fleet? Okay. I take back everything I said about grumpy generals.

e0377382.say: We are through the Sky Gate! Ee-ee-tees’s fleet is turning back. Every single ship.

a1eea6af.say: He held off a whole fleet. On his own. With a Shield.

24acab4f.say: Not on my own. My Legion stood with me. And the sprout. She is very brave, for a plant.

ec47a369.say: Thank you, General. We’ll find the Fleece. For Celestia.

5e38bc98.say: Then go, Argonauts. The garden is waiting. I will catch you up: old soldiers are slow, but we always arrive.

24cd4772.say: Taking her down through the clouds. Everyone, look out of the window... the Garden of Colchis.

fdce7afc.say: Listen. The whole garden is breathing slowly now, in time with the dragon’s snores.

631c30be.say: It’s smiling in its sleep! I made a dragon Smile. I am putting that on my list of skills.

8bd77e2e.say: The tree-temple doors are open. The Fleece vault is right inside. Last one in is a slow harpy!

a3c703c2.say: Careful, Argonauts. Ee-ee-tees’s gold ships are circling Colchis. He knows exactly where you are going.

ccebe4bd.say: Then we’d better get to the Fleece first. Celestia is waiting for it. Let’s go!

cfd507f2.say: The first verse! And look: the light melted one of Ee-ee-tees’s gold chains!

62c8b732.say: Two chains gone. It is pulling at the last ones. Careful, everyone!

299498d5.say: Three! One more pylon and the lullaby is ready... and the dragon is free. Get ready!

12ff4307.say: It yawned! It is getting tired. Keep going: the song is starting to work!

926de7f2.say: Its eyes are drooping! Just a little more!
